body:
And I'll take on the cost of living crisis
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260223-2546)
Peter,
Politicians keep telling us the economy is doing great. On paper, wages are keeping up with inflation.
But in reality, we’re working twice as hard to get half as much. The things we actually need to survive — healthcare, housing, childcare, education — are devouring entire paychecks.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260223.6sMaVg&amount=5&refcode=em20260223-2546&t=19&akid=2546%2E105371%2EWZYNQb)**
The [cost](https://act.francescahong.com/go/4969?t=20&akid=2546%2E105371%2EWZYNQb) of hospital services in Wisconsin has gone up 274% since 2000. Rent is up 136%. College tuition is up 188%. Your household income? Only up about 90%.
We’re in an affordability emergency. The status quo isn’t cutting it. That’s why I’m running for governor.
Permanent affordability is the heart of my agenda, and I have a plan to directly lower costs for Wisconsin families:
* Universal childcare – because no parent should pay more for infant care than for a year of college tuition. And when parents can stay in the workforce, the economy can grow.
* Paid leave for all – because 3 out of 4 Wisconsin workers don’t have it.
* Fully funded public schools — because when the state won't fund our schools, your property taxes go up instead.
* Fairer, cheaper healthcare — because a 274% increase in hospital costs isn't something you can budget your way out of.
* Raise the minimum wage — because Wisconsin's has been frozen at $7.25 since 2009.

That's not a radical wish list. It's an affordability agenda. And it's why I'm running for governor.
This campaign is powered by people, not corporations. Our median donation is $15, and today we’re asking for just half of that.
**[Can you give $7.25 to help us fight for a living wage?](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260223.6sMaVg&refcode=em20260223-2546&t=21&akid=2546%2E105371%2EWZYNQb)**
Invest one minimum wage hour in our campaign today, so we can create a much higher one for you.
— Fran
[**P.S. And if you can do $15 — our median gift — you'd be doubling down on the movement. Every dollar matters when you're running a campaign this way.**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260223.6sMaVg&refcode=em20260223-2546&t=22&akid=2546%2E105371%2EWZYNQb)

Dear friend,

As I’m writing to you, snow is falling heavily and steadily in Connecticut. It instantly brought me back to my trip this past week, where I traveled to Ukraine as part of a delegation of U.S. Senators. We visited Odesa, a Black Sea port city that has been under constant threat during Russia’s brutal invasion.
While there, a brutal winter storm swept through the city. But even as the snow fell, we saw soldiers, port workers, and families show up to defend their country and keep the community going.
Standing in the snow, I thought about the courage it takes to endure four years of war and **still** refuse to give up.

That’s the spirit I saw across Ukraine, and that’s the spirit I came home determined to bring back with me to the United States.
During the trip, President Zelenskyy also honored me with Ukraine’s Order of Prince Yaroslav the Wise, an award given for strengthening international support for the state. It was deeply humbling, but the real honor was meeting the people on the front lines fighting every day for their freedom.
The message was clear: _Democracy is worth defending._
That’s why I continue to push for support and stronger sanctions on Russia. The Ukrainian people deserve peace – one that preserves their freedom.
But the work doesn’t stop abroad; here at home we are facing our own test. Powerful forces are trying to weaken democratic institutions, divide our communities, and pull us away from our values. We must have the courage to stand up, myself in the Senate, against these threats. **[So if you believe as I do that democracy is worth defending everywhere, please chip in today to help power our fight.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125990654/603560686/-1799740860?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1438-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzM0NzZlYzMtMTMxMS1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FnI8ci1SoIIORkLbW3vkajAjJIXgrvf5GpuVbKScFsQ=)**

When you deposit money into a bank, you're technically loaning it to them...

But here's the harsh truth : When you deposit money into a bank, you're technically loaning it to them... And if that bank gets into financial trouble, they can use YOUR deposits to save their own skin. It's called a "bail-in" and it's been 100% legal in America since 2010. Find out more on the next page This isn't conspiracy theory stuff... During financial crises, this exact thing happened in Cyprus in 2013 and in Lebanon in 2019. In Lebanon: There were more than $72 BILLION in losses... Depositors faced ~$400 monthly withdrawal restrictions on their accounts... And some even turned to armed robbery of their own banks in a desperate attempt to access their life savings. Now, if you're thinking this can happen in America because we're "covered by FDIC insurance"... That's true... But it's only up to $250,000 per account... | Friend, I'm Bob Brooks. I'm a firefighter, a dad, and someone who has spent his life working hard for myself, my family, and my community.

I'm running to defeat Republican Ryan Mackenzie in PA-07. Last year, he won this race by just one percentage point. Next year, we have the chance to defeat him.

[I want to tell you a bit more about who I am and why I'm running for Congress, but if you're already with me in the fight to flip this competitive seat, then I'm humbly asking you to split a donation between the Voter Protection Project and me →](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/103879?t=6&akid=23094%2E878179%2EMLLQW5) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Bob Brooks and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/103880?t=7&akid=23094%2E878179%2EMLLQW5)

From a young age, I worked plenty of different jobs. Paperboy, fry cook, dishwasher, bartender, pizza delivery driver — you name it, I did it. I know what it's like to clock in early, work hard, and still wonder if you're getting ahead.

But in 2005, I found my passion: I became a firefighter with the city of Bethlehem.

I spent 20 years there because fighting fires was more than just a job for me — it was about serving my community and standing up for the people who keep us safe.

**That's why I'm so proud to have earned the endorsements of Senator Bernie Sanders, Governor Josh Shapiro, Senator Ruben Gallego, and Secretary Pete Buttigieg. They know what this fight is about — standing up for working people against the billionaires and special interests.**

Republicans in Congress like Ryan Mackenzie are spending their time prioritizing Donald Trump and the wealthy billionaires who back their campaigns.

While families in PA-07 struggle with rising costs and making ends meet, Mackenzie is busy supporting policies that slash Medicaid and SNAP to pay for tax cuts to the rich and powerful.

We deserve better. We deserve someone who understands what working class families and small business owners are going through. We need someone who knows what it means to work hard and still wonder if you're going to get by.

I'm that person, friend. I'm running so that I can fight for you, the people.

Thank you,
Bob

body:
This is a hard chapter,but it's not the whole story.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=2860%2E21716%2E-OxRDi)
A few weeks ago, we sent out a survey to learn more about the issues that concern you the most about the Trump administration and Republicans in Congress — and what’s keeping hope alive for you.
We got _hundreds_ of responses. Across them, a few themes came through loud and clear.
First, a **deep-seated fear about the future of our democracy.** So many of you wrote about the attacks on our voting rights. Gerrymandering, voter roll purges, threats of interference with this year’s election cycle, and the erosion of checks and balances. A president who ignores court rulings, pressures the Department of Justice to serve his personal interests, and disregards his oath to protect and defend the Constitution in pursuit of unbridled power and riches.
Second, **the alarming cruelty.** Many of you shared your concerns about ICE becoming a paramilitary-like force, deportations without due process, and what feels like the dehumanization of people becoming normalized. Communities are living in fear, and the basic civil rights that should protect every person in this country have been violated.
Lastly, **the pressures on working people.** From rent to health care, costs are skyrocketing, threats to social security and Medicare are on the rise, public education is under attack, and environmental protections are being gutted even as climate disasters intensify. All while the wealthy get wealthier, and working people are left to bear their burdens alone.
**First, I want to say: I hear you. Thank you for having the courage to come forward and be frank about what concerns you about our future.**
I share many of these concerns. It’s why I get up every single day to fight tooth and nail in Congress. It’s why I’ve stood up against the Trump administration’s executive overreach and the efforts to undermine free and fair elections, the cruelty of ICE, and the erosion of due process, and why I continue to fight to safeguard our democracy and push for a transparent, accountable government that works for _everyone,_ not just the wealthy few at the top.
[**If you believe in holding power accountable, will you pitch in $5 today to help me continue standing up to Trump and fighting for our democracy?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260223-2.kp2vKK&refcode=em20260223-2860&amount=5&t=2&akid=2860%2E21716%2E-OxRDi)
I didn’t just ask about your concerns — I wanted to know what sustains you in this fight, too. And amidst those fears and anxiety, your answers reminded me of why there are so many reasons not to give up hope.
Neighbors helping neighbors, strangers showing kindness, and communities organizing mutual aid. Many of you spoke about the peaceful protests across the country, about Minnesotans and others standing up to the egregious abuses of power by Kristi Noem and her DHS, and about the young people who have refused to be silent on the issues that weigh on their hearts and minds.
Democrats are winning special elections. There is clear momentum building towards the midterms, and the possibility of taking back the House to put a real check on this president is palpable.
Others found hope in our shared history — in the fact that even during the darkest chapters this country has faced, we have emerged better than before because everyday people chose courage over fear.
**Lastly, many of you said something that struck me deeply: that having leaders who are willing to speak out and stand firm in their values gives you hope.**
I don’t take that responsibility lightly. And your reasons for continuing to persevere even when the light at the end of the tunnel seems dim are what make you an invaluable part of this movement.
When I won my election last year, I said that hope is not naive or pretending like things aren’t hard. It’s a discipline. A conscious decision to believe that progress is still possible — and to act like it.
Your responses showed me something powerful — that even in anger and fear, you care deeply about democracy. You care about your neighbors and leaving a better world for the next generation.
That gives _me_ hope.
We’re in a hard chapter, but this chapter is not the whole story.
[**Can you chip in $5 today to help me keep fighting in Congress and take back the House this November?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260223-2.kp2vKK&refcode=em20260223-2860&amount=5&t=3&akid=2860%2E21716%2E-OxRDi)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260223-2.kp2vKK&amount=5&refcode=em20260223-2860&t=22&akid=2860%2E21716%2E-OxRDi)**
Thank you for sticking with me — I’m grateful to be a part of this movement with you. I will continue to stand up with clarity, courage, and hope, and to fight to deliver for Delawareans with everything I’ve got.
With gratitude,
Sarah McBride

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Mother Jones: Republican Justices Appear Poised to Destroy What’s Left of the Voting Rights Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022326_3&amount=25]
We'll hand this straight to Mother Jones, Team: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. "
The descriptive language seems harsh, but the objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
During recent oral arguments in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.

At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down redistricting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
“ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’”
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $35 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022326_3&amount=35]

clean_body: This bill could disenfranchise tens of millions of American voters | | | House GOP passes sweeping anti-voting bill that could disenfranchise millions, sends measure to Senate —Democracy Docket We don’t have much time. Earlier this month, the U.S. House of Representatives voted to pass the SAVE Act, a sweeping voter suppression bill backed by Donald Trump that could block tens of millions of Americans from voting. The bill will head to the U.S. Senate next. Donald Trump is lighting a fire under Senate Republicans to pass this voter suppression bill with measures that one historian called “the most extraordinary attack on voting rights in American history” and “an attempt to destroy American democracy as we know it.” The so-called SAVE Act could block tens of millions of eligible American voters from casting their ballots. It’s a modern-day poll tax that would force people to show expensive government documents in person before registering to vote — documents that 21 million Americans do not have easy access to. We’re fighting to stop the SAVE Act by mobilizing people in key states to contact their Senators. We’re raising the alarm about the harm this bill would do to our democracy. And we’re working to make sure voters have the information they need to participate in free and fair elections. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- We should all have an equal say in our democracy, but anti-voter laws limit whose voice gets heard in elections. The SAVE Act would put particular burdens on working-class Americans, communities of color, military voters, tribal citizens, rural Americans, survivors of natural disasters, and tens of millions of married women who’ve changed their names. It could also enable future voter purges, which are notorious for removing eligible Americans from the rolls. And Senate Republicans are so eager to pass this anti-voter bill that they’re scheming about changing the filibuster rules — which could allow them to ram through this legislation on a party-line vote. By passing laws that place new obstacles between voters and the ballot box, extreme lawmakers think they can shield themselves from accountability. They think they can give themselves free rein to enact radical, unpopular policies — like more tax breaks for billionaires and more health care cuts for working people — without worrying about fair competition in fair elections. But we’re fighting to stop their voter suppression. And activists like you have the power to help defend the freedom to vote from anti-democracy forces. = In solidarity, The Fair Fight Action Team P.S. Senators are still making up their minds, and they need to hear from you — constituent voices go a long way to show where the public stands on critical issues. Friend – something’s been on my mind, and I need to know where you stand on it.
Donald Trump and his allies claim they’re championing “meritocracy.” But that’s absurd.
You can’t lecture me about “merit” and then make Pete Hegseth your Secretary of Defense.
You can’t lecture me about “merit” and then make Robert F. Kennedy Jr. your Secretary of Health and Human Services. You can’t lecture me about “merit” and then make Kash Patel your FBI Director.
You can’t preach about promoting a “meritocracy” while filling your Cabinet with the most unfit, unqualified people ever selected.
**Let’s be clear: I’m doing everything I can to hold the line against this dangerous administration, and I need to know if you’re as concerned as I am about the threats Trump’s Cabinet poses to our country. Please, let me know now:**
**Do you approve of Trump’s Cabinet?**

Friend, I want America to win – because I love this country.
I love it in the same way we love our families. Many families have a complicated story. I carry in my veins the brutal side of that. My daddy had to give up his bus seat while wearing his soldier’s uniform – but because we kept fighting for America, his son now sits in a _Senate_ seat.
No matter what Trump and his allies throw at us, I’ll never give up on the fight to make this country a better place. I’m grateful to know you’re with me in this fight.
Thanks for speaking out,
Rev. Raphael Warnock

body:
| | | | | [|

| | | | | |

Team Mackenzie,**Thank you. Truly—thank you.** Because of your hard work, dedication, and belief in our campaign, today we were able to file more than 1,000 nomination petition signatures to get on the ballot for Congress this year.That is more than 1,000 signatures in less than a week! I’m proud to share that not only are we the first congressional campaign in PA-7 to file nominating petitions, but we are the first Republican in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania to file in any race.That milestone belongs to you.This achievement was made possible by your commitment, your time, and your determination. I am deeply humbled by the outpouring of support and honored to serve as your Congressman. I never take your trust or your effort for granted.**But we aren’t done yet!** While filing first was a big accomplishment, our next goal is to file thousands of more signatures to show the wide community support our campaign has this year. **That’s why, for everyone still circulating petitions, I ask you: please don’t stop! KEEP GOING!!!** We need the signatures you are still collecting to increase our totals even more – and make sure the DC Democrat political machine can’t “challenge” our petitions. **That’s why I am urging you: do NOT stop gathering signatures.** Our team will continue submitting additional signatures to the Pennsylvania Department of State, so every name you collect still matters. Every signature strengthens our campaign and ensures we are in the strongest possible position moving forward.Thank you again for everything you’ve done—and everything you continue to do.Gratefully,Congressman Mackenzie

body:
#
Peter —
Time is running out in this race, and thousands of undecided Texans are still making up their minds before they cast their ballot in the next 8 days.
One big question folks are asking is: “Which campaign has the best chance to flip Texas?” So it’s our job to make clear that James and this people-powered movement have what it takes.
One way we’re trying to do that is by showing grassroots momentum with a list of personal endorsers — to show that the people are behind James.
**[So if you agree that James is the best candidate to take back Texas, will you add your name to personally endorse our movement for the U.S. Senate? We are looking to have as many people as possible show their support today.](https://act.jamestalarico.com/signup/endorse-em-260223/?source=em260223-2-ak&refcode2=466.1347274.AiemKO&akid=466%2E1347274%2EAiemKO)**

It may seem like this is a small action, but it has a big impact.
The primary is March 3, and early voting is happening now. We need to prove that we have the depth of grassroots support required to win a state as big and diverse as Texas.
Pulling off such a historic feat requires building the largest grassroots movement that Texas has ever seen.
We’re well on our way. James is in the middle of a 12-city Take Back Texas tour. We are holding massive events in every corner of Texas. Nobody gets taken for granted in this campaign.
It’s important to know you’re with us too. Each person who adds their name helps us send a message about the strength of this movement.
**[Will you please add your name to personally endorse James Talarico? It would mean a lot to him to know you have his back in this final sprint.](https://act.jamestalarico.com/signup/endorse-em-260223/?source=em260223-2-ak&refcode2=466.1347274.AiemKO&akid=466%2E1347274%2EAiemKO)**

Dolly the living legend. She just seems to get more popular by the day. What is it that makes her such an Icon? Why is she so loved by so many? She has such a mass appeal. She definitely has beauty and her figure helped make her a household name.
Her voice is like a southern song bird. She strokes her vocal cords with such ease and the song writing ability is beyond genius. She is funny, witty and has great timing. Another tidbit that some of you all might not know is that she is a smart and savvy business woman as well. She has been a creative entrepreneur for decades.
She has probably lost some and failed at a few things I'm sure like all entrepreneurs but gaining much more through the years.
Also when there was a huge fire in Gatlinburg TN near her hometown she was so giving of her time and resources helping families who had lost everything. She has a philanthropic spirit knowing she can never out give God. He always gives more which is the true meaning of success in my opinion. If you plant good seeds and keep giving you will reap a great harvest.

Some of my favorite Dolly memories are, I was 7 years old and roller skating on our back patio and a Dolly song came on. I skidded to a stop and yelled at my mom through the kitchen window, "Mom! This is Dolly right!?" "This song makes me want to be a singer songwriter and move to Nashville!" My mom smiled and said, "Honey with God all things are possible."
"Well mom, if Dolly can do it then Why Not Me?" That is when I began my love for country music and I was all in getting my hands on and learning every Dolly song I could.

Then years later I had moved to Nashville and had the opportunity to hear her perform at the Ryman Auditorium. I was in awe as she waltzed on stage in all her sparkle and shine singing "Why'd you come in here looking like that" The audience was on their feet full of absolute joy and wonder.
When there was a quiet moment in the show a man shouted out "I love you Dolly!"
And in her witty on her feet can't stump Dolly way she answered back "Now I told you to stay in the truck!" The crowd went wild! Classic!

Then as the years went by and I opened my cupcake shop off of music row I got a call from her assistant saying she was in love with my coconut cupcakes and wanted to order 24 for her staff and could we deliver to her compound on 12 south down the street from the shop? Are you kidding me! Absolutely! I personally delivered them although I didn't get to meet Dolly that day it was still an honor to know that her favorite cupcake was a Gigis coconut cupcake.

As I strolled into Walmart today a smile crossed my face as I pushed my cart past the isle with all the Duncan Hines Dolly Parton cake mix in the pink boxes. You go Dolly!
One day I want to meet you and hopefully bake you some coconut cupcakes.
Hey, maybe one day we can bake together? www.walmart.com/c/kp/duncan-hines-dolly-parton

**Coconut cupcakes**

In the spirit of the Dolly Brand use her white cake mix and follow recipe
After mixed put in 1 cup of sweetened coconut
Add 2 tps of coconut extract mix in
Put in cupcake liner and bake as directed
While baking make frosting
I/2 butter
1/2 Crisco
Mix well with mixer
Add 2 tps of vanilla
Add 2 tps of coconut extract blend
Add 3 Tbs of milk
Add 4 cups of powdered sugar - Blend until fluffy
When cupcakes are cooled with pastry bag frost cupcakes then put coconut flakes on top and press gently to make it stick.

Enjoy and thank you for reading my tribute to Dolly Parton!

My mom smiled and said, "Honey with God all things are possible." "Well mom, if Dolly can do it then Why Not Me?" That is when I began my love for country music and I was all in getting my hands on and learning every Dolly song I could. Then years later I had moved to Nashville and had the opportunity to hear her perform at the Ryman Auditorium. I was in awe as she waltzed on stage in all her sparkle and shine singing "Why'd you come in here looking like that" The audience was on their feet full of absolute joy and wonder. When there was a quiet moment in the show a man shouted out "I love you Dolly!" And in her witty on her feet can't stump Dolly way she answered back "Now I told you to stay in the truck!" The crowd went wild! Classic! Then as the years went by and I opened my cupcake shop off of music row I got a call from her assistant saying she was in love with my coconut cupcakes and wanted to order 24 for her staff and could we deliver to her compound on 12 south down the street from the shop? Are you kidding me! Absolutely! I personally delivered them although I didn't get to meet Dolly that day it was still an honor to know that her favorite cupcake was a Gigis coconut cupcake. As I strolled into Walmart today a smile crossed my face as I pushed my cart past the isle with all the Duncan Hines Dolly Parton cake mix in the pink boxes. You go Dolly! One day I want to meet you and hopefully bake you some coconut cupcakes. Hey, maybe one day we can bake together? www.walmart.com/c/kp/duncan-hines-dolly-parton Coconut cupcakes In the spirit of the Dolly Brand use her white cake mix and follow recipe After mixed put in 1 cup of sweetened coconut Add 2 tps of coconut extract mix in Put in cupcake liner and bake as directed While baking make frosting I/2 butter 1/2 Crisco Mix well with mixer Add 2 tps of vanilla Add 2 tps of coconut extract blend Add 3 Tbs of milk Add 4 cups of powdered sugar - Blend until fluffy When cupcakes are cooled with pastry bag frost cupcakes then put coconut flakes on top and press gently to make it stick. Enjoy and thank you for reading my tribute to Dolly Parton! Editorial comments expressed in this column are the sold opinion of the writer. This Substack is reader-supported. Not because corporations say so --
but because people do._
Dear Valued Subscriber and Movie & Music Lovers,
The final month of voting for the **[2nd Annual Heartland AwardsTM](https://substack.com/redirect/6df25b3f-d3d3-44a7-b5b1-b81a719b1dcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** is here -- and the race is closer than you might think. Every category is still very much up for grabs, and your vote -- and the votes of everyone you know -- could decide who takes the crown in April.
We've been overwhelmed by the response from our community. Thousands of heartland voices have already cast their ballots, and the leaderboard below shows just how tight the competition has become. But voting closes **March 31st at midnight** , and we need you to make some noise before then.
Forward this email. Share the link. Tag a friend who loves country, Americana, film, and the artists who carry the heartland spirit. Because unlike corporate award shows driven by boardrooms and sponsor agendas -- this one belongs entirely to you.
**[Voting closes March 31st at midnight.](https://substack.com/redirect/6df25b3f-d3d3-44a7-b5b1-b81a719b1dcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Winners announced in April. Every vote carries equal weight, and every voice matters.

name: Rob Bonta
subject: Out-of-state politicians don’t get to decide California’s reproductive freedoms
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROB BONTA FOR CALIFORNIA ATTORNEY GENERAL 2026 FPPC ID #145642
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=25]
Friends, let me be clear about one thing today: California remains a safe haven for reproductive freedom.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/pQCSlntyCk-PQDaWsV8CVQ2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pQCSlntyCk-PQDaWsV8CVQ2]
We’ve now seen firsthand that extremists won’t stop their anti-abortion attacks at state lines.
I’ve issued a bulletin to California law enforcement — and I want you to know this, too:
California law prohibits cooperation with out-of-state investigations or prosecutions of abortions that are lawful here in our state.
We will not allow anti-abortion extremists from outside our state to reach in and undermine the protections guaranteed here.
Whether these attacks come from the Trump administration or from another state, the answer is the same: California will not comply.
Here’s what that looks like in practice:
→ California agencies cannot arrest, investigate, extradite, or share information about reproductive care that is lawful in this state — even if another state demands it.
→ Doctors and patients will not face surveillance, arrest, or prosecution in California for lawful care.
Californians have already made our position clear on this issue. We’ve protested, we’ve elected champions of reproductive freedom, and we’ve voted overwhelmingly to enshrine these rights in our state Constitution.
We will continue to ensure individuals can safely access reproductive health care because that is the will of the people.
As Attorney General, I’ll do everything I can to enforce the law and ensure people can access care. But the fact remains that it is under attack, so I need to know you’re with me on this.
Sign on if you agree: No state gets to criminalize health care that’s legal here. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pQCSlntyCk-PQDaWsV8CVQ2]
ADD YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pQCSlntyCk-PQDaWsV8CVQ2]
We will defend California’s patients and providers, and we will enforce California law — period.
In solidarity,
Rob

name: Judicial Watch Tipsheet
subject: Judicial Watch: New FBI Records Reveal Warnings about Suspicious Individual before Trump Shooting in Butler
body:
Judicial Watch announced that it forced the release of 37 heavily redacted pages from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit revealing that law enforcement personnel broadcast radio warnings about an “unknown male acting suspiciously” prior to the attempted assassination of then-candidate Donald Trump at a July 13, 2024, rally in Butler, PA. These are the first records the FBI has released about the Butler assassination attempt on Trump.

**[You’re Already Ahead of the Crowd...](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)** **The Only Question Is - How Far Ahead?** You wouldn’t be reading this if something hadn’t already caught your attention. The tone has shifted. Not in headlines. Not in retail chatter. _But in positioning._ Global debt is at historic levels. [**Central banks are accumulating gold at record pace.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) And serious capital is adjusting quietly. While everyday investors debate short-term price moves, institutions are reallocating exposure. Central banks. Sovereign funds. Large capital pools. They don’t announce transitions. **[They position first — and explain later.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)** Here’s what most people don’t realize until hindsight makes it obvious: **Almost everything written for retail investors is noise.** Recycled narratives. Oversimplified charts. Emotion-driven commentary designed to hold attention — not transfer insight. Very little explains how institutional capital is thinking about gold heading into 2026. Even less explains why that thinking is shifting now. **[That’s why this guide exists.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)** It doesn’t speculate. It doesn’t predict prices. It doesn’t manufacture urgency. **Instead, it breaks down:**
* How institutional allocation toward gold is **evolving**
* What central banks are **doing differently** with reserves
* The macro forces influencing **long-term demand**
* **What large capital is preparing for** — before it becomes consensus

This isn’t about timing a spike. It’s about not being late to a structural adjustment. **[And this guide isn’t meant for everyone.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)** **It’s for those who:**
* **Value positioning** over prediction
* **Prefer preparation** over reaction
* **Understand that clarity** often precedes opportunity

If gold is going to play a meaningful role in the next phase of the global financial system, understanding institutional positioning before it becomes obvious is simply prudent. **[REVIEW THE GUIDE.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)** Because once positioning becomes visible to the public, the advantage has already shifted. name: Esther Kim Varet
subject: We need your help!
body:
Hello everyone,

We’re collecting a number of voter signatures to place Esther Kim Varet on the ballot for the 2026 Congressional Election in California’s 40th Congressional District.

Because CA-40 boundaries changed under Proposition 50, only voters registered in the new CA-40 map are eligible. In addition, _signatures must come from voters registered in Orange County, as we are filing with the Orange County Registrar of Voters_. Please take a moment to check your voter registration to confirm eligibility.

On Tuesday, February 24, campaign team members will be available to collect signatures at the locations below. The process takes just a minute.

Signature Collection – February 24

* **High Ground Coffee House (Mission Viejo)** \- 11:00am - 1:30pm
* **Starbucks (Rancho Santa Margarita)** \- 2:00pm - 4:00pm

name: Esther Kim Varet
subject: We need your help!
body:
Hello everyone,

We’re collecting a number of voter signatures to place Esther Kim Varet on the ballot for the 2026 Congressional Election in California’s 40th Congressional District.

Because CA-40 boundaries changed under Proposition 50, only voters registered in the new CA-40 map are eligible. In addition, _signatures must come from voters registered in Orange County, as we are filing with the Orange County Registrar of Voters_. Please take a moment to check your voter registration to confirm eligibility.

On Tuesday, February 24, campaign team members will be available to collect signatures at the locations below. The process takes just a minute.

Signature Collection – February 24

* **High Ground Coffee House (Mission Viejo)** \- 11:00am - 1:30pm
* **Starbucks (Rancho Santa Margarita)** \- 2:00pm - 4:00pm
* **High Ground Coffee House (Mission Viejo)** \- 4:30pm - 5:30pm
* **Rockwell 's Cafe and Bakery (Villa Park)** \- 3:00pm - 4:00pm
* **CAVA (Anaheim Hills)** \- 5:00pm - 6:00pm

If none of these times work but you’re willing to sign, please email **Alex** ([alex@estherkimvaret.com](mailto:alex@estherkimvaret.com)), and we’ll coordinate another option. Feel free to share with other eligible CA-40 supporters.

Thank you for your support.

Team EKV

| | Dear Delegates,
With county conventions taking place this Thursday, we are in the final stretch of this race.
I did not enter this contest on a whim. I stepped forward after careful consideration because Michigan cannot afford eight more years of the same agenda. I have the experience, leadership, and a plan necessary to defeat the Democratic nominee. I am ready to win Michigan.
Michigan deserves an Attorney General who shows up, listens, and works hard. That is exactly what I have done and will continue to do. Over the past seven months, I have visited 68 of Michigan's 83 counties, logged more than 40,000 miles meeting with delegates, listening to your concerns, and sharing my vision to restore integrity and refocus the Attorney General's Office on its core constitutional and statutory duties. I have personally called thousands of precinct delegates, and our volunteers have reached thousands more. This campaign is about people, priorities, trust, and confidence, not rhetoric. Leadership is not about talking. It is about showing up.
How You Can Help This Week

* Attend your county convention and become a Delegate or Alternate to the State Convention.

* Speak with fellow delegates about why you support this campaign.

## Blizzard Buries the Northeast
The Blizzard of 2026 dumped over 2 feet of snow from New Jersey to New England on Monday, knocking out power to more than 644,000 customers and shutting down travel across the I-95 corridor. [Follow live updates here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAQhZ8Gd6wAY_AWFGnc3bQpLX7Gu8SYsQCvde_TR94kT3DLmW80R-f79TF_2Jhifvy0G5i24JzhrAlagzK7FL--bAm4CCZUwIctGxabw3zNlAkq5BxsTJ-z7IJZAAT0HRiuNb_3XIxD9zROq0XB6GAE76W-Mx78orWVUvV6WPoumusbE0JyzkYmb9yNITgLPTitlRqIZBBiw3L7jTG3JyzpE19Qbh63Lplna3sl_Q8iJiKm8zxv1vvjBNuef2-ImCBfKOYGhf4jREwpvoBefYmYMhaw9eLv7bEH26BSl9Cv7niD_zromtGvleLR6I4nFNqQDoyt1PqCtdJI7wP1WEoMeOXwUSnJRFdM2M-YUqxKE8kem43pXaJ9y_zLiD8BAAD__wQtmXo). Providence, Rhode Island, shattered its all-time single-storm snowfall record set during the [Blizzard of 1978](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOwyAUBNDTQBcLvrEhBcU27rLtlgj8PwkRNhFBsezTr7xX2HI00pNmfm7u5lNO6_3bL2RbLG6l7Z2pNaou5HQcvmKJIGDEcvd1KdWv6M58EXAB5dCnvDvF0UYioJ6TlVrLay_BDPxhr9ErQaOeIwpplDESpAyotceBej_zZE9NACgphRGqk8EgBk89Ba3HcWBKEKZWavcsaW0PinkvH6rdXBae7aO115v1XwwmBtO2bV0I89kxmM4xDKacPsRgmnf9XJ-HHsg0Xi2-tpRzeo-aKXFffMp_YvvXDR8LvwEAAP__45RvcQ). Two people were killed in Maryland when a tree struck their vehicle. New York City issued its first blizzard warning in nearly a decade, with Central Park recording 19.7 inches. [See photos from NYC here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL0OnDAQhJ8GOiN7bX5SuEhDd2lTogUvsImxT7bvEPf0Efl5gnS7mtFo5vv-mB7InsP2DQ-yZY1ToDN7KoXSNHv-fDC5uIKEzsUN0xETBjfdv5AgwEwO2V-TqZ1diYB0TVb1vfqiFQxtvVsDWtK6tHrQ2EKnaMDF9DO2BluN3VKzvdMkgFFKDtI0ah6cm5E0zX3fdW1lJDkuMTU_Ioey0-qv-KbULPGovd1LeeZKf61grGA8z7MpfFB8lVuvYAx0XjH9_HPlCkalBIeMgcSTl_JKlEVcRbgW4V6JwybKTuLAnPlN4h-D2_J3NWjo6mTd82TvOXd9ZeR2IPvfhcp_UXxb-BUAAP__SXGFeA). More than [8,000 flights were canceled](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuhDAQRU9jOpA9GMMWLtLQbdqUaMwM4MjYK2Mt2j19RKScIN2MnvS-_v-6T3f0wcf1E3e2ZUlT5PMIXArnyQX_fmOmtIAEQ2nFvKeMkabrryXUoCdCH16TrsguzMBtxVb1vbq1Coau2ixop5QyC5lbR8PgJFCn6WZIOkTCrvL2skkArZQcpG6UG4gccsuu743phJZMvqTcfCcfy8ZLeKUn52ZOexXsVsrjEO2HgFHAeJ5nM0c3X1DAeKkFjBKuu704Y9k410vw61bqGePMIWDxKR71X-E6psx4FM7NVvZQZUuP04fgD9MLLdcdffhNL_-a7GnhJwAA__8XsX7p), and travel bans forced schools, buses, and rail service to shut down across the tri-state area. | Peter,
2026 is a make or break election year for democracy.
All of the talking heads are talking about the House and Senate elections, and yes, those will be consequential. But here's the truth most political pundits and election analysts are missing:
The fate of Democracy will also hinge on often overlooked and underappreciated state Supreme Courts races.
As MAGA witnessed the formation of a massive blue wave in 2025, they started working on desperate countermeasures, launching an all-out blitz of anti-democratic election rigging efforts at the state level--rewriting elections laws to make it harder for Democrats to vote and gerrymandering maps.
The constitutionality of their actions will ultimately be decided by state Supreme Courts. That means whoever controls these courts will control the fate of our Democracy:

32 states will have state Supreme Court elections in 2026 including the key swing states of Michigan, Georgia, and Wisconsin. If MAGA loyalists capture these courts, they'll green-light voter suppression and rigged maps as "constitutional".
That's why Defend Our Courts is stepping up once again. In 2025, when control of the PA Supreme Court was on the line, we helped lead the defense of the court and secure a 30+ point victory for the Democratic justices.
Now we're taking that winning formula national.
The national party is going to be stretched thin. With dozens of competitive House and Senate races, state court elections will risk being ignored. We can't let that happen, not when the entire guardrail of democracy is on the line.
[The sooner we get moving, the stronger we'll be in every state. We need to start preparing our defense now and we can't do it alone. In Mississippi today, more people than ever are earning a living outside the traditional 9-to-5 job. From electricians and truckers to freelance nurses, software developers, hairstylists, and Uber drivers, independent contracting is no longer a side hustle--it's a core part of our economy.

Yet our laws haven't kept up. Benefits like health coverage, disability insurance, and retirement savings are still built around the old model of a single employer and a single job. That leaves independent contractors with a harsh choice: either stick with rigid employment structures or forgo the benefits that help families weather hard times.

House Bill 1072, the Voluntary Portable Benefit Plan Act, offers a better path--one that respects freedom, encourages work, and keeps government in its proper lane.

**Here 's what the bill does, in plain language.**

HB 1072 allows companies that hire independent contractors to voluntarily put money into special "portable benefit" accounts for those workers. These benefits are "portable" because they follow the worker, not the company. If a contractor works for three different hiring parties, each can contribute to the same benefit account.

The contributions are tax-deductible for the business, just like benefit expenses for regular employees. For the independent contractor, that money does not count as taxable income. In other words, both sides get a tax-neutral way to arrange benefits, without creating a new government program or changing anyone's employment status.

No one is forced to participate. Businesses don't have to offer contributions. Contractors don't have to accept them. There are no mandates, no new entitlements, and no bureaucratic benefits scheme run out of Jackson or Washington. HB 1072 simply gets government out of the way so private parties can make voluntary arrangements that fit their needs.

That matters for liberty.

First, HB 1072 protects freedom of contract. Right now, many businesses are afraid to help independent contractors with benefits because they worry it will be used against them in court as "proof" the worker is really an employee. This bill gives them a safe, clear path to help without triggering a legal trap. It respects adults' right to make their own agreements.

Second, it avoids the heavy-handed approach we've seen in other states, where lawmakers try to "solve" the gig economy by forcing companies to reclassify contractors as employees. Those efforts destroy flexibility, reduce opportunities, and push people into one-size-fits-all arrangements. HB 1072 does the opposite: it preserves choice while expanding options.

Consider a single mom who pieces together income by driving for a rideshare service, delivering groceries, and doing bookkeeping from home. Under HB 1072, each hiring party could voluntarily contribute small amounts to her portable benefit account. Over time, she could build a cushion for health expenses or lost income if she's hurt and can't work. No bureaucracy. No mandate. Just people cooperating on mutually beneficial terms.

This is what limited, constitutional government looks like: setting fair tax rules, protecting rights, and then stepping back so free people and free markets can innovate.

Mississippi should welcome new ways to work and earn a living without punishing those who don't fit an old model. HB 1072 keeps benefits decisions where they belong--between individuals and the organizations they choose to work with.

Lawmakers should pass HB 1072, and citizens who value work, choice, and personal responsibility should urge them to do so. This is a chance to modernize our laws without growing government--and we shouldn't let it pass us by.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. Plus, I've received a 96% 4 star rating from [Grassroots North Carolina ](https://aliforcongress.com/so/faPoFoM5_/c?w=PlWAeg1huIlJ6Giyn8blFsgB3xOfniXrrY7TLnlcn04.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ncm5jLm9yZy93cC93cC1jb250ZW50L3VwbG9hZHMvMjAyNi8wMi9HUk5DLTIwMjYtUHJpbWFyeS1Wb3Rlci1HdWlkZS1OYW1lLXNvcnQtdjcucGRmIiwiciI6IjY3N2EwYzdmLTNmMTQtNDVmMi04MDI2LWU1YzBlMzM0NDdkMiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI4NmFmOTdkLTczMWQtNDc2Mi04ZGI5LWVkMDA2MmI0NzNkYyJ9)for my strong support of Second Amendment rights, compared to my primary opponent's 0% score. Extreme ideas like ending earned benefits such as Social Security won't just hurt our state legislature and local candidates; they'll also jeopardize the US Senate race. We need to continue to deliver messaging about how Republican policies focus on safer communities through tough-on-crime measures and support for law enforcement, lower costs via tax cuts and deregulation, and more opportunities for everyone by promoting free-market innovation and improved education. name: Jon Ossoff
subject: You’re seeing what I’m seeing, right?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
#

[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260224-1-f&refcode2=1711.5691347.ZLoi2D&t=1&akid=1711%2E5691347%2EZLoi2D)
---
Hey, it's Jon: [**Can you please rush $5 — or whatever you can — to my reelection campaign here in Georgia?**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260224-1-f&t=2&akid=1711%2E5691347%2EZLoi2D)
_Look, you’re seeing what I’m seeing, right?_
You see our government transformed into a tool of one man's personal vengeance and power and enrichment.
You see the President and his family raking in billions while Americans struggle to make ends meet.
You see prices going up while jobs are getting harder to find.
You see millions lose insurance and local hospitals shut services while the rich get tax cuts.
You see masked federal agents kicking down doors without so much as a warrant from a judge, dragging Americans without cause, demanding papers at police checkpoints, assaulting and even killing Americans with impunity from the very top.
Maybe you fear whether our Republic, now in our 250th year, can survive it all.
But trust me when I tell you: _We will overcome this together._
The only way out of this darkness is to win the midterms. And this Senate race in Georgia is PIVOTAL.
In 2021, I won election to the U.S. Senate by just over 1%. It was close! But thanks to you, we had the resources to win.
But it’s a different — and even tougher — race this time around. Make no mistake: MAGA is coming for this seat. The GOP is already pouring millions into Georgia to take me down.
I am their #1 target in the midterms, and they will use every lie and dirty trick in the book against me.
We have a tough fight ahead of us, but with your help, we'll have the resources needed to fight back and WIN Georgia once again. So I’m asking:
Can I count on you to make a contribution to my campaign today? Here’s a link to give $5 or whatever you can: [**https://act.electjon.com/go/Jon-February-Supporters**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260224-1-f&t=3&akid=1711%2E5691347%2EZLoi2D)
Thank you, for everything.
Jon

Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Thank you for supporting Jon Ossoff. Email is a critical way to keep up with Jon and his work in the US Senate, but you can click [here](https://act.electjon.com/signup/fewer-emails-signup/?t=4&akid=1711%2E5691347%2EZLoi2D) to sign up to receive fewer emails, or click [here](https://act.electjon.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=5&akid=1711%2E5691347%2EZLoi2D) if you'd like to unsubscribe.

| Peter,
---
| Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

Peter, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book.

It's not a culture war manifesto.

It's a call to stop.

To rest. To breathe. To return to God.

**Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. **

Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away.

Hi friend,
Welcome to the first edition of our campaign newsletter! We're excited to launch this regular update as a way to stay more closely connected with you and share what we've been working on, what we're hearing from voters, and how you can be part of the movement we're building together.
### **What We 've Been Up To**
Over the past few weeks, our campaign has been focused on showing up, speaking out, and staying rooted in the issues that matter most to our community. Here's a snapshot of what we've been working on:
* **Listening to voters and elevating local concerns.** We've been out in the community talking directly with neighbors, hearing what's on their minds, and making sure those voices are front and center in this campaign. A few weeks ago, [Rachel held a town hall](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5ede0e2e-2d14-453c-ba97-53582e775ab1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to discuss the news of the Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) facilities coming to Berks and Schuylkill Counties -- without community input. Dan Meuser has offered no leadership (and even said the facilities will have a ["positive impact"](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0bd4522c-2e6f-4ac7-93c8-d0be7299215e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). Meanwhile, local and county officials are left scrambling to respond to these facilities, which will threaten public safety, increase local taxes, and tear at the fabric of our community.
* **Holding Dan Meuser accountable.** We've continued to call out actions and inaction that don't serve our district, [specifically Meuser's vote to cut health care from nearly 450,000 Pennsylvanians](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0003e0c6-455a-49f8-b3b0-538a876ad607?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and jack up insurance prices for everyone else. [Nearly 20% of Pennsylvania residents dropped their health insurance coverage because it's just too expensive.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/652e79c9-21ee-4f9d-bc55-46c21d54acbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) This is the reality of policies Dan Meuser voted for -- and we deserve so much better.
* **Building momentum on the ground.** From [Winterfest in Pottsville](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/860a6896-4e80-47d8-a7f2-36fac4820f61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to a tour of [Williamsport](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/23c62b12-7355-4d92-80f5-e2c53a0517be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (in the cold!), to visiting the [Carpenters Local 431 in Lebanon](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8698a8fe-8c18-4ac9-8e2f-eacc9ba37ffd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we're growing this movement by connecting with people where they are.

| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/96cda862-2604-4ded-801b-190534fe9dd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

---|---|---
**If you have events in your area you 'd like to invite Rachel to, please get in touch with us at [info@wallaceforcongress.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/81fb92d6-0dce-4ebe-82a0-9fd3b0b2c3ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
### **📢 Get Involved**
* **Volunteer opportunities.** Petition season is in full swing, and we need your help to get Rachel on the ballot. Interested in collecting signatures? It's easy! Reach out to us at [info@wallaceforcongress.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/81fb92d6-0dce-4ebe-82a0-9fd3b0b2c3ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and we'll get you set up.
* **Follow us on social, and share our posts with your friends.** Help us get the word out about the campaign, and Rachel's priorities! See links to our channels at the bottom of this page.
* **Support our campaign.** Grassroots supporters power our campaign -- [chip in if you can and help power us through to Election Day.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ec0e9384-0084-4fe7-b504-021b04c9cc7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Thanks for being part of our campaign. We're just getting started.
With gratitude,
Kate
Team Wallace for Congress

Friends,
I'm asking you--personally--to join me for something important.
Instead of sitting through another Trump State of the Union spectacle, we're coming together for **State of the Swamp** , a live pro-democracy rebuttal hosted by Defiance.org at the National Press Club in Washington, D.C., streaming _**tonight February 24 at 7 p.m. ET.**_
[ Sign up for State of the Swamp NOW](https://substack.com/redirect/68dd4218-8319-42af-ad61-7b359af1d4af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I am in DC, here in person. Blue Amp Media Contributing Editor Ellie Leonard is here, too. And a wide range of pro-democracy leaders, public figures, elected officials, and former Trump administration voices will be delivering real-time response and accountability while the speech unfolds.
This isn't just commentary. It's production. Music. Satire. Sharp analysis. Yes, even frog costumes. And you can play SOTU Bingo with us during the livestream.
👉 [Sign up for the live feed of State of the Swamp here](https://substack.com/redirect/68dd4218-8319-42af-ad61-7b359af1d4af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Here's the part I want to be transparent about: this event is expensive to produce. Ticket sales help cover those real costs and support future civic organizing focused on holding Trump accountable for abuses of power. When you buy a stream, you're helping fuel that work--and you're supporting independent voices like ours at Blue Amp Media.

Hi Peter,
I have said it already but it is worth repeating — I have never been so proud to be a Minnesotan . Seeing Minnesotans take care of each other and stand together has been incredible to witness. We did not back down in the face of Trump’s cruelty, and we showed the nation how to stand up to this administration.
But make no mistake — our work is far from over.
This lawless administration must be reined in and held accountable, and the checks and balances our Constitution enumerates must be restored.
To do so, we must win the majority in the U.S. House this November. Every dollar I raise goes towards keeping my seat blue, helping Democrats across the Third Congressional District, and supporting targeted races in neighboring Wisconsin and Iowa to take back the House.
Peter, I would be honored if you would be willing to chip in towards this work. Any amount makes a difference, and you can do so online here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-email]
I am more determined than ever to do everything I can to bring our democracy back from the brink and begin rebuilding our remarkable and resilient country. Thank you so much for your partnership in this fight!
With gratitude and resolve,
Congresswoman Kelly Morrison

El Paso.
Parkland.
Las Vegas.
Uvalde.

We deserve better.
We need politicians who aren’t afraid to stand up to the gun lobby. And if they can’t muster up the courage to take action, then we must replace them with leaders who can.
**That’s the work we are doing at GIFFORDS.** No matter what Donald Trump says tonight, GIFFORDS will continue fighting for a world free from gun violence — one voter at a time.

Team, it's Senator Schumer with an important question.

**Is there anything Donald Trump can say in his State of the Union address tonight that would motivate you to[donate $5 (becomes $15) to help elect Democrats, so we can win a majority to hold him accountable?](https://go.dscc.org/go/22943?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20260224-ChuckSchumer-PreSOTUAnythingTrumpCanSay-ETG-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260224-ChuckSchumer-PreSOTUAnythingTrumpCanSay-ETG-sl1&akid=22864%2E9716520%2EIn0vZs)**

Tonight, Trump will be plastered all over every major news channel. He'll say whatever it takes to rile up his MAGA base _against_ Democrats and discourage Americans like _you_ from combating his lies.

What if he lies about our crumbling economy, calls affordability a "hoax," and claims health care has never been cheaper ‐‐ _even though he's made ALL of it worse?_

What if he denies the chaos and corruption he's causing ‐‐ _as if he didn't turn over the keys of his administration to his buddy Elon Musk?_

What if he demands to "nationalize the voting" and "take over" elections ahead of the midterms ‐‐ _just as voters head to the polls to try to stop him?_

**This is what unchecked power looks like, friends.** Trump's bragging about all of the havoc he's wrought on the American people and telling bald-faced lies to minimize his _many_ failures. **And as long as Republicans control the Senate, they'll keep enabling the very _worst_ of it.**

That's why taking back the Senate majority is crucial. We can put real limits on Trump's abuses, protect access to affordable health care, fight to lower costs, and hold this administration accountable.

**So please, with the State of the Union coming up, I'm personally asking:[Can I count on you to make a $5 donation _(matched to $15)_ to help us hit our $250,000 end-of-month fundraising goal to flip the Senate blue and combat Trump's lies by unseating his worst enablers?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/22943?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20260224-ChuckSchumer-PreSOTUAnythingTrumpCanSay-ETG-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260224-ChuckSchumer-PreSOTUAnythingTrumpCanSay-ETG-sl1&akid=22864%2E9716520%2EIn0vZs)

Thank you,

Chuck

You should not have to pay rent to the government to live in a house you **OWN**.

And when I'm Governor of California, you won't.

The tax collectors are losing their minds at my decision:
* **When you pay off your home, your property taxes will end.**
* **When you turn 65, no more property taxes.**

Usually, in California, when a Republican says "I'll cut your taxes", the Establishment and Supermajority Democrats ignore it.

| Fellow Patriot,
---
| Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

clean_body: Not just preached Stop, in the Name of God. | | | | Fellow Patriot, | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... | This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Fellow Patriot, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Fellow Patriot, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... And a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA | - P.S.Stop, in the Name of God is Charlie Kirk's final message -- written in obedience, shaped by Scripture, and grounded in trust in the Lord. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: The message Charlie carried into eternity
body:
[unsubscribe](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xul=1nmc5a54x67zfmd5fi2bt1ih26q023bmwpx9feccvhq4v4s4j93pkvty6jq2z3ihvxyzg0bfbrmxlz68d38mpod6oe6tvglidjd3swogyimbqmye6efw&__stmp=taz0eh&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.

Steve Thompson, Editor
* * *

| | | [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz0eh&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz0eh&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz0eh&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz0eh&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz0eh&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz0eh&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz0eh&__onlt=h)

**P.S.** When you read **_Stop, in the Name of God,_** you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead.

**[I hope you’ll claim your copy by making your most generous gift to Turning Point USA. Your support fuels our work to build the most faithful generation of Americans in history. Thank you, and God bless!](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz0eh&__onlt=h)**

| Good morning Friend,
**Mississippi has one of the strongest energy advantages in the country.** Affordable, reliable power has become one of the key reasons major companies are investing billions of dollars in our state. From manufacturing to data centers to industrial expansion, energy costs matter — and Mississippi is winning. The question is: **how do we protect and strengthen that advantage?**
---
