name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: This is what gave Charlie strength
body:
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz7zl&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz7zl&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz7zl&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz7zl&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz7zl&__onlt=h)**
---

**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz7zl&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz8fi&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz8fi&__onlt=h)**

---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=taz8fi&__onlt=h)**

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us. I believe you will find this book inspiring. Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life. In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans... ...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — it’s the message of FAITH! In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God. Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. And it’s happening. After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country. What we’re witnessing is not just growth —it’s revival. At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old. We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families. We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message. You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie. But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up. All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, “We’re not backing down.” This is what Charlie prayed for. I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too. None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith. Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God. I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible. Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. When you read Stop, in the Name of God, you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead. ** 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 / / AFFILIATE DISCLOSURE NOTICE: You should assume the sender of this message has a financial or affiliate relationship with the persons or companies referenced and may be compensated for purchases made via linked sites. Connecticut families and businesses are paying some of the highest electricity rates in America. _**High energy costs function like a hidden tax -- driving away manufacturers, discouraging AI and data center investment, and squeezing middle-class households already stretched thin.**_
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=189049980&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg5MDQ5OTgwLCJpYXQiOjE3NzE5NjEyOTksImV4cCI6MTc3NDU1MzI5OSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.ODsg8enGeg1m_ItpGf2FYI9-tFenVt3rbSX9GHf5Wuw)
At the same time, Connecticut is home to one of the most advanced nuclear engineering hubs in the world.
General Dynamics Electric Boat in Groton builds the most sophisticated nuclear-powered submarines ever deployed. Just down the shoreline, Millstone Power Station provides the majority of New England's carbon-free baseload power (at rates lower than the future offshore windmill fantasy of revolution wind).
This is one of the few times where CT already has the expertise and the workforce. We already understand nuclear energy. It's time to harness it for Connecticut with the support of the Federal Government.
So here is a serious question:
When nuclear submarines are retired, why do we dismantle their reactors instead of repurposing them to power our electric grid?
**From the Depths to the Grid**
Modern submarine reactors are engineering marvels. They are compact, shielded, shock-resistant, and designed to operate safely for 33 to 40 years without refueling. Each can generate roughly 230 megawatts of electricity -- enough to power tens of thousands of homes.
Instead of scrapping that capability, Connecticut could explore a bold alternative and this is our proposal:
* Remove the reactor module from a decommissioned submarine
* Refuel it
* Retrofit it for stationary electricity generation
* Install it at a secure coastal or existing grid site

Estimated refueling and retrofit costs (on the high side) could be around $1 billion per reactor. Three repurposed units could generate nearly 700 megawatts of consistent, zero-carbon electricity -- comparable to the overpriced large offshore wind installations of Revolution Wind costing over $6 billion, but without the intermittency or weather dependency
Retrofitting is much more cost effective than building a new nuclear power plant. To build a new 230 megawatt nuclear power plant it would cost an average of $18,000 per kilowatt or $4.14 billion.
_**This is not anti-wind or anti-renewable. It is pro-reliability and pro-affordability.**_
**Why Reliability Matters**
AI facilities, advanced manufacturing plants, and semiconductor operations require steady, 24/7 baseload power. Wind and solar fluctuate. Batteries are expensive and limited in duration. Natural gas faces pipeline constraints and regulatory barriers in the Northeast.
Naval reactors, by contrast, are built for endurance and stability. They operate continuously. They are already engineered to extreme safety standards. And they are compact -- requiring a far smaller footprint than many alternative energy projects.
_**If Connecticut wants to attract the industries of the future, reliability must come before rhetoric.**_
**Jobs, Innovation, and Leadership**
Exploring submarine reactor repurposing would:
* Create high-paying nuclear engineering and technical jobs
* Strengthen federal-state partnerships
* Expand Connecticut's leadership in advanced energy
* Reduce long-term electricity volatility

It would send a message to investors and manufacturers: Connecticut is serious about innovation and affordability.
It's time for a Connecticut Solution to a Connecticut Problem with Connecticut knowhow.

clean_body: Repurposing Decommissioned Nuclear Submarine Reactors For Real Energy Solutions | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more The Goldstein Substack - A Father-Son Publication Dr. Goldstein is Running for Congress and his page can be found Repurposing Decommissioned Nuclear Submarine Reactors For Real Energy Solutions | | and | Feb 24 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Connecticut families and businesses are paying some of the highest electricity rates in America. High energy costs function like a hidden tax -- driving away manufacturers, discouraging AI and data center investment, and squeezing middle-class households already stretched thin. At the same time, Connecticut is home to one of the most advanced nuclear engineering hubs in the world. General Dynamics Electric Boat in Groton builds the most sophisticated nuclear-powered submarines ever deployed. Just down the shoreline, Millstone Power Station provides the majority of New England's carbon-free baseload power (at rates lower than the future offshore windmill fantasy of revolution wind). This is one of the few times where CT already has the expertise and the workforce. We already understand nuclear energy. It's time to harness it for Connecticut with the support of the Federal Government. So here is a serious question: When nuclear submarines are retired, why do we dismantle their reactors instead of repurposing them to power our electric grid? From the Depths to the Grid Modern submarine reactors are engineering marvels. They are compact, shielded, shock-resistant, and designed to operate safely for 33 to 40 years without refueling. Each can generate roughly 230 megawatts of electricity -- enough to power tens of thousands of homes. Instead of scrapping that capability, Connecticut could explore a bold alternative and this is our proposal: Remove the reactor module from a decommissioned submarine Refuel it Retrofit it for stationary electricity generation Install it at a secure coastal or existing grid site Estimated refueling and retrofit costs (on the high side) could be around $1 billion per reactor. Three repurposed units could generate nearly 700 megawatts of consistent, zero-carbon electricity -- comparable to the overpriced large offshore wind installations of Revolution Wind costing over $6 billion, but without the intermittency or weather dependency Retrofitting is much more cost effective than building a new nuclear power plant. To build a new 230 megawatt nuclear power plant it would cost an average of $18,000 per kilowatt or $4.14 billion. This is not anti-wind or anti-renewable. It is pro-reliability and pro-affordability. Why Reliability Matters AI facilities, advanced manufacturing plants, and semiconductor operations require steady, 24/7 baseload power. Wind and solar fluctuate. Batteries are expensive and limited in duration. Natural gas faces pipeline constraints and regulatory barriers in the Northeast. Naval reactors, by contrast, are built for endurance and stability. They operate continuously. They are already engineered to extreme safety standards. And they are compact -- requiring a far smaller footprint than many alternative energy projects. If Connecticut wants to attract the industries of the future, reliability must come before rhetoric. Jobs, Innovation, and Leadership Exploring submarine reactor repurposing would: Create high-paying nuclear engineering and technical jobs Strengthen federal-state partnerships Expand Connecticut's leadership in advanced energy * Reduce long-term electricity volatility It would send a message to investors and manufacturers: Connecticut is serious about innovation and affordability. It's time for a Connecticut Solution to a Connecticut Problem with Connecticut knowhow. | A guest post by| Consultant, Political Consultant, Campaign Manager, Construction Consultant and Corporate Attorney. name: Team Cooper for NC
subject: The gloves are coming off.
body:
Buckle up.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=631%2E124072%2EIQ8TjG)
Peter, We’re exactly one week away from our primary, which means soon Roy will be the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in North Carolina! It also means this race is about to kick into high gear. Mega-donor GOP groups are lining up to pour money into this fight, and we have to be ready for it. This is shaping up to be the most expensive U.S. Senate race in the country, and we can’t fight back without your help. **[Contributing any amount today, no matter how small, will help us prepare for the onslaught of GOP spending. Will you send a contribution today to help us prepare? Any amount makes a big difference>>>](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5887?t=7&akid=631%2E124072%2EIQ8TjG)** It doesn’t matter if you’re part of the Wolfpack, a Blue Devil, a Tar Heel or a candidate for higher office — the key to winning is always preparation. We know big far-right GOP groups are going to do everything they can to drown out our message with a tidal wave of cash. But here’s the thing: Roy has never lost a race in North Carolina. We’ve assembled the best team, and we have the best supporters. Our policies and messages win, and we’re ready to flip this seat blue. The only thing we need is you. **[Let’s leave it all on the field. Take a quick second and make a donation today>>>](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5887?t=8&akid=631%2E124072%2EIQ8TjG)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5888?t=9&akid=631%2E124072%2EIQ8TjG)

---
[DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5893?t=14&akid=631%2E124072%2EIQ8TjG)
---
With so much gratitude,
Team Cooper
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

**[Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/1914?source=&t=2&akid=631%2E124072%2EIQ8TjG)**

body:
I am genuinely sorry, Peter.
Really, I am.
I am sorry some folks threaten to remove you from the GOP if you don't donate.
I am sorry some folks masquerade as President Trump to try and fool you.
I am sorry some folks don't even thank you for donating.
It is enough to drive you nuts. And I completely understand how you feel because I get the same messages. I'll get bombarded with texts and emails asking me for money but it's hard to tell who sends them all.
And if I do pitch in a few bucks, I'd probably get pestered even more - without any acknowledgement of my contribution.
It's wrong, and I'm doing things differently.
This is Steve Scalise. First of all, I want to personally thank you for everything you've done to help elect President Trump and Republicans thus far. [You are the lifeblood of the MAGA movement – and we only won with your hard work and support.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/ufMtKYUuzO60nrZEnOXbl0QQP-QDN3fu3J8cQJjY6EyQGEBrYUVRsV_ZmFXgyCEq-hur1k8zZj48km01-EjA-ZEyWzVMoRFE1yFjwNMFWGyoLPBReRFYdsA2NMOmOvdz7zJ6utoqrZ6hqbsvzheqwpS9BGkCIy2wAmEjRSL4eTpCq_sto4Ds2T78jpZSroaee_doaHtg7Z1GEBefP_amrzlzogMHLECe5AxmR7kZLVpNspZhY2cVCv01tMJJnq8rvFkfSBlRlqqazkGXYiAPCsFANwlX7LJfakyA5N1oGQ-rRXKAk3RkBHSLdJs3WZcuFsoptnEQwl_xZXMouxQb7ZwNA9OG91U1yb0jEWhJ59u6jS4VHKeG5l68a_V38gXmhTAz2X-wOlmhJ3og0FulTWGEMZCDUburS0PxqQkMqaL_34-S0zeW2S1cwWptrFUijdJiawjgbyawLJ4vsPgxyvaaKXdXO90f9b9dc_zNbfg37Ht2MgSguXHYWnfXx2uKIw10Z34MU0aGeiYrVDvyybzsAIPWF9TR14G8a9CgSQhouGau5AcGnBMbdBBQ582HbkfbH8YA5pt6HG5jGG6Ae7QqOFDuqVNbssVs6le8hb4FzjnXU0livbL71rOERRU_ErtErXJcCkMLMvoXgUXyd01T2c3bN6lw4NJU3AUSB5tSegwP5c12zgLaorif_2uNdCsD3DUTNioXWOrX7unhj6yuzAKKsdwrwi9BAG3Rfq9CPjbhgn4b36HB7tLU5wnT7i-qHuTdszqGxJ4i2b0v05qs5uAy1qdHaO4EbL2TM9Fgjq1y-5RhCSHWxGz1grl1jGN1ROQz6ThBQMsBBQI030_yIvV28j2IlA/-5aETLU7R3U4j_QCf8lhkLJ8tkgVCEVG/18)

name: Kerry McQuisten (Newsletter)
subject: I know. I skipped January!
body:
| | | | |
---
_Above: Bob Spicher of the Oregon Conservative Caucus welcomes a proud new American in Portland._
---
Hello, everyone! I know, I know ... I skipped the January newsletter. My schedule has been so hectic that I wound up triaging things, so the newsletter and podcast took a backseat. A temporarily messed-up shoulder hasn't helped things either, but physical therapy is a terrific invention.
**Oregon Conservative Caucus**
After watching what worked and didn't work during our first full year of operations, we revised our bylaws and changed up our structure last month. I can already tell we're more effective this way. One of our new projects involves being a constant presence at naturalization ceremonies where LEGAL immigrants are finishing the process of becoming American citizens _the right way_.
For decades, the Democratic Party of Oregon has been lurking outside to recruit these new Americans right after they take their oaths, which are done in Portland, Eugene, and Pendleton. I think our Portland "task force" created quite the shock wave, with Democrats asking them, "Why are you here? What are you doing?" Apparently, "Registering voters," wasn't the desired response. There was an incident with one of them physically tugging at a clipboard and another when a lady demanded to know what one of our volunteer's tattoos meant. Pretty funny! Our efforts blow their "Republicans hate minorities and immigrants" narrative out of the water. We don't hate either of those groups - it's just that we don't care much for criminals who have come into our country illegally and continue to commit more crime. Big difference.
Anyway, OCC members warmly welcomed our newest Americans - and registered them Republican. Finding freedom in America is a beautiful thing.
**D.C. Again!**
We _thought_ we were headed to D.C. in February, but that trip was pushed back to next month. D.C. _always_ has collective "squirrel!" syndrome. When something big happens internationally, everyone instantly drops whatever they're focusing on domestically. And vice versa. When shutdowns happen, so do delays. Eventually, things get back on track.
Solomon and I will be headed out to meet with senior White House staff, our Republicans Overseas (RO) team, and most likely a cabinet member soon. The legislative support for our efforts has already been overwhelming. Background: Thanks to Obama, the U.S. is one of only four nations worldwide that double-taxes our citizens who live and work overseas. This structure is grossly unfair. President Trump cut a [video ](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/CMGvZiIgfPUE5_wFnCFOug~~/AAAHURA~/wCeag-ICZUExvuRIBm7l_hvZGWgkEXA3GJ9qXKnDnW1NUL14tkse76cEYd5BT_7wiZ5nLEveswYq1LTSqkNDzR7slbwziBg8CQPeG_DA4Bfp0fgk126QmsPFK67oAbGmbYHhiibh_D7G-Pleisg__PVRRGue7trdLqSg7ByVCAQyjj0joSoqPjFTZIMzbgwO)for us during his campaign, and when we're successful with our federal efforts to end double-taxation, we'll be righting a wrong and also helping him keep one of the very few campaign promises he hasn't been able to get through just yet. Our project has gained support and generated some positive surprise twists every month. While we accomplish this goal, we've also come up with a way to right a second wrong at the same time. I would _really _like to type out a truly juicy, victorious newsletter about this soon! **The Book**
_Counterscript: A Personal and Political Memoir_ should finally be out this summer. We're done with the first draft and a round of editing, and are headed into round two. David Bossie, President Trump's former deputy campaign manager, is writing the foreword. In total with the photo gallery, this book will be over 500 pages in the end; it documents Solomon's childhood and escape from China and why the fight against the CCP is so important. This book brought out a lot of laughter and tears in its making...
More in March after we get through our next D.C. trip.
_Kerry_

clean_body: | | | | | Above: Bob Spicher of the Oregon Conservative Caucus welcomes a proud new American in Portland. Hello, everyone! I know, I know ... I skipped the January newsletter. My schedule has been so hectic that I wound up triaging things, so the newsletter and podcast took a backseat. A temporarily messed-up shoulder hasn't helped things either, but physical therapy is a terrific invention. Oregon Conservative Caucus After watching what worked and didn't work during our first full year of operations, we revised our bylaws and changed up our structure last month. I can already tell we're more effective this way. One of our new projects involves being a constant presence at naturalization ceremonies where LEGAL immigrants are finishing the process of becoming American citizens the right way. For decades, the Democratic Party of Oregon has been lurking outside to recruit these new Americans right after they take their oaths, which are done in Portland, Eugene, and Pendleton. I think our Portland "task force" created quite the shock wave, with Democrats asking them, "Why are you here? What are you doing?" Apparently, "Registering voters," wasn't the desired response. There was an incident with one of them physically tugging at a clipboard and another when a lady demanded to know what one of our volunteer's tattoos meant. Pretty funny! Our efforts blow their "Republicans hate minorities and immigrants" narrative out of the water. We don't hate either of those groups - it's just that we don't care much for criminals who have come into our country illegally and continue to commit more crime. Big difference. Anyway, OCC members warmly welcomed our newest Americans - and registered them Republican. Finding freedom in America is a beautiful thing. D.C. Again! We thought we were headed to D.C. in February, but that trip was pushed back to next month. D.C. always has collective "squirrel!" syndrome. When something big happens internationally, everyone instantly drops whatever they're focusing on domestically. And vice versa. When shutdowns happen, so do delays. Eventually, things get back on track. Solomon and I will be headed out to meet with senior White House staff, our Republicans Overseas (RO) team, and most likely a cabinet member soon. The legislative support for our efforts has already been overwhelming. Background: Thanks to Obama, the U.S. is one of only four nations worldwide that double-taxes our citizens who live and work overseas. This structure is grossly unfair. President Trump cut a us during his campaign, and when we're successful with our federal efforts to end double-taxation, we'll be righting a wrong and also helping him keep one of the very few campaign promises he hasn't been able to get through just yet. Our project has gained support and generated some positive surprise twists every month. While we accomplish this goal, we've also come up with a way to right a second wrong at the same time. I would really like to type out a truly juicy, victorious newsletter about this soon! The Book Counterscript: A Personal and Political Memoir should finally be out this summer. We're done with the first draft and a round of editing, and are headed into round two. David Bossie, President Trump's former deputy campaign manager, is writing the foreword. In total with the photo gallery, this book will be over 500 pages in the end; it documents Solomon's childhood and escape from China and why the fight against the CCP is so important. This book brought out a lot of laughter and tears in its making... More in March after we get through our next D.C. trip. Kerry A sneak peek from the book's photo gallery: Solomon in Alaska at Alyeska Ski Resort. His college had organized a trip to attend a sunrise service. Let me back up and give you the full story...

Back in 2018, the Left convinced Utah's voters to (barely) approve a cleverly worded ballot initiative named Prop 4.

To voters, it sounded harmless._It wasn 't. _

Prop 4 took redistricting power away from elected lawmakers and voters... and handed it to an unelected "independent" commission.

_Translation? _

A backdoor way to carve out a Left-wing seat in Congress in deep-red Utah. A quiet map-rigging operation.

And for weeks, the headlines screamed that the effort to repeal Prop 4 was doomed to fail.

_" They don't have the numbers"... "They can't get enough signatures"... "It's too late." _

That's what they said.

But the Left and their parrots in the media forgot something...

They forgot about the patriots in Utah who had already been working diligently for months. They forgot about the grassroots.

**And they forgot about what happens when Turning Point Action dives into a fight. **

By Illinois Review

Gov. JB Pritzker’s latest political miscalculation may have done more than cost Illinois the Chicago Bears. Political strategists now say it could have ended his long-rumored path to a presidential run.

The Chicago Bears are reportedly moving closer to building a new stadium in Indiana, a stunning development that insiders say caught the governor’s office completely off guard.

For years, Pritzker and Illinois Democrats acted as if the team would never seriously consider leaving. That assumption now looks like an epic fumble.

Sources close to political consultants in both parties say the fallout is real. One national strategist described it as “a leadership failure of epic proportions.” Another said, “If you can’t keep an iconic NFL franchise in your own state, how do you argue you’re ready to lead the country?”

The Bears have called Illinois home for more than a century. Losing them would be more than symbolic. It would be an economic and cultural blow. And voters know it.

Illinois has already seen a steady stream of companies pack up and leave. In recent years, major employers like Boeing, Caterpillar, Tyson Foods, and Citadel have moved headquarters or expanded elsewhere.

The state continues to struggle with high taxes, rising crime, and heavy regulations – all under one-party Democrat control.

Now, the Bears may join that list.

| Peter,
---
| Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

It's not a culture war manifesto.

It's a call to stop.

To rest. To breathe. To return to God.

**Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. **

Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away.

Trust that God is in control.

Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship.

**In _Stop, in the Name of God,_ you'll discover: **

🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout

🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer

🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation

Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again.

That's the heartbeat of his final message.

clean_body: It wasn’t about politics... Stop, in the Name of God. | | | | Peter, | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... | This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Peter, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Peter, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... And a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA | P.S.Stop, in the Name of God is Charlie Kirk's final message -- written in obedience, shaped by Scripture, and grounded in trust in the Lord. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

REGISTER FOR THE STATE OF THE SWAMP [https://www.defiance.org/sotu#register]
This administration would like nothing more than for everyone to forget about Jeffrey Epstein, his decades of abuse, and his web of associates—including Donald Trump.
We will not allow Epstein survivors to be silenced.
We need accountability. We need trials. We need justice.
The president is trying to hide and rewrite history, but I won’t let that happen. Here’s some of what I’m doing to ensure accountability:
I am a proud co-sponsor of the Epstein Files Transparency Act , which would force the administration to release all of the Epstein files, only withholding information that protects victims.
I am having Lisa Phillips, one of the brave survivors of Epstein’s human trafficking ring, attend the State of the Union on my behalf. Her story—and the experience of so many girls like her—will not be erased.
I’m going to the Department of Justice to review the unredacted Epstein files, where I will do my best to identify and report back on the information survivors are seeking.
Donald Trump and his administration continue to lie, spread misinformation, and intimidate survivors in an attempt to bury this story. But a government must be accountable to the people it serves. We cannot, and will not, let the predators associated with Jeffrey Epstein get away with this.
If you agree that we need justice and hold POTUS and his predator friends accountable, chip in what you can today to fuel the fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q1?refcode=x_260224_epsteinfiles_act]

Team,

Winning in November means keeping constant contact with voters year round, not just reaching out when we want them to vote for our candidates.

So that’s what the goal of this year has been.

We started with a wide-ranging billboard campaign, placing billboards all across IL-15 so voters can see how and why Mary Miller has failed them. We are also running digital ads throughout the IL-15 highlighting Miller’s failures.

Ken DeGraaf argues [HB26-1081 would expand costly grid mandates that raise rates and risk reliability](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while promoting his bill HB26-1246 as a more market-driven path forward. Meanwhile, Democrats advance a bill to [fully decriminalize prostitution statewide](https://link.email.joinrmv.)—supporters call it safer, critics warn it could fuel trafficking and override local control.

Federal judges continue [rejecting broad immigration detention authority](https://link.email.joinrmv.), and no appellate court has yet ruled on whether Tina Peters’ speech was [improperly used to deny her bond](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Congress is considering the bipartisan [Fix Our Forests Act to combat megafires](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while the Supreme Court ruled 6–3 that [Congress—not the president—holds tariff authority](https://link.email.joinrmv.). [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
More than half a million signatures were gathered and delivered with a single stated aim, placing before Colorado voters a set of measures supporters say are designed to protect children.
Protect Kids Colorado (PKC) says it submitted more than 170,000 signatures for Proposition 109, formally titled the “Protect Women and Girls Sports Act.” The filed text would require school-sponsored athletic teams to be expressly designated as male, female or coeducational, and would prohibit male students from participating on teams reserved for “females, women or girls.”
For Proposition 110, the group reported more than 164,000 signatures. That measure would prohibit a health-care professional from performing surgery on a minor “for the purpose of altering biological sex characteristics,” and would bar the use of state or federal funds for those procedures.

**[The question no court has answered: Was Tina Peters jailed for speech?](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **No court has ruled on the First Amendment question:** Despite months of litigation, no appellate court has decided whether Tina Peters’ protected speech was improperly used to justify denying her bond.
* **State and federal courts sidestepped the constitutional issue:** Colorado’s appellate court dismissed her bond challenge as untimely, while a federal judge declined to weigh in under the Younger abstention doctrine, leaving the core free-speech claim unresolved.
* **The case now advances to the Tenth Circuit:** With both her state appeal and federal habeas challenge moving forward, the central question remains whether speech—not violence or flight risk—was used to keep her behind bars.

We’re one week out from the March 3rd primaries.
I’ve been traveling across Texas, visiting college campuses and talking with students, registering voters, and listening to what’s on their minds. I can tell you this: people are ready for change and they’re ready to do the work to win it.
That’s why we organize everywhere, not just where Democrats traditionally show up. Our volunteers are in every county, on every campus, in every community to listen first, build trust, register voters, follow up, and stay long after the headlines move on.
Here’s what gives me hope: we have Democrats running for every single seat in Texas. Congress, State House, and State Senate races; not one has been left uncontested. That only happens when people decide Texas is worth fighting for.
At Powered by People, our volunteers and organizers are doing the work that wins—reaching voters ahead of next week’s primaries, preparing for local elections this spring, and working towards victory in November.

Peter, **Tonight, the President will stand before Congress to deliver his State of the Union. And I won’t be in that chamber. But I want you to hear directly from me about why.** The State of the Union is supposed to be a moment for truth. A moment to reflect on where we are as a nation — our progress, our pain, and the work ahead to move forward together. **And we all know that’s not what will happen tonight.** I will not sit quietly through another speech filled with division, deflection, and misinformation. I won’t be part of the set piece that normalizes cruelty, attacks on our constitutional rights, and the targeting of vulnerable communities. [_**If you believe we must meet this moment with courage instead of cruelty, truth instead of spin, and community instead of division — will you chip in $5 or whatever you can right now to help us fight back?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126051659/603759142/-925888159?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzlkMWM4Mi1iZDExLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DHC4xybpKCQ--jME7R3265fumAU1n1o51sDe3SDPSq8=) Instead, tonight I’ll be on the National Mall at the People’s State of the Union — standing alongside organizers, advocates, and Americans whose lives have been directly impacted by this administration’s policies. **And I want to tell you about someone who will be there with me.** My guest tonight is Mohsen Mahdawi — a Vermont community member, a student leader, and a fierce advocate for human rights. Mohsen came to this country believing in its promise. He built a life in Vermont rooted in belonging and service. But on the very day he was supposed to complete his citizenship process — the final step in becoming an American — he was detained by ICE without charges. **Why? Because he used his voice. Because he spoke up for Palestinian human rights.** **[CHIP IN TO HELP US SEND A MESSAGE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126051660/603759143/-925888159?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzlkMWM4Mi1iZDExLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DHC4xybpKCQ--jME7R3265fumAU1n1o51sDe3SDPSq8=)** I got involved in his case because free speech doesn’t belong to some of us, it belongs to all of us. And I believed then, as I do now, that targeting someone for their advocacy is a direct threat to the Constitution we are sworn to protect. **After months of pressure, advocacy, and organizing, Mohsen was released, and just last week, an immigration judge ruled that he cannot be deported.** Tonight, we stand together. In compassion. In courage. In the belief that kindness and fierce determination can coexist. **That is the real state of our union.** Not the one you’ll hear about from that podium — but the one built by people supporting each other, defending rights, and refusing to give in to fear. I know so many of you are feeling overwhelmed right now. I hear it everywhere I go. But I want you to know this: **your voice matters. Your engagement matters. And your support makes all of this work possible.** So, If you believe in meeting this moment with grit and heart...
If you believe in defending free speech and constitutional rights...

clean_body: I'll be standing with the people. | = Peter, Tonight, the President will stand before Congress to deliver his State of the Union. And I won’t be in that chamber. But I want you to hear directly from me about why. The State of the Union is supposed to be a moment for truth. A moment to reflect on where we are as a nation — our progress, our pain, and the work ahead to move forward together. And we all know that’s not what will happen tonight. I will not sit quietly through another speech filled with division, deflection, and misinformation. I won’t be part of the set piece that normalizes cruelty, attacks on our constitutional rights, and the targeting of vulnerable communities. = Instead, tonight I’ll be on the National Mall at the People’s State of the Union — standing alongside organizers, advocates, and Americans whose lives have been directly impacted by this administration’s policies. And I want to tell you about someone who will be there with me. My guest tonight is Mohsen Mahdawi — a Vermont community member, a student leader, and a fierce advocate for human rights. Mohsen came to this country believing in its promise. He built a life in Vermont rooted in belonging and service. But on the very day he was supposed to complete his citizenship process — the final step in becoming an American — he was detained by ICE without charges. Why? Because he used his voice. Because he spoke up for Palestinian human rights. = I got involved in his case because free speech doesn’t belong to some of us, it belongs to all of us. And I believed then, as I do now, that targeting someone for their advocacy is a direct threat to the Constitution we are sworn to protect. After months of pressure, advocacy, and organizing, Mohsen was released, and just last week, an immigration judge ruled that he cannot be deported. Tonight, we stand together. In compassion. In courage. In the belief that kindness and fierce determination can coexist. That is the real state of our union. Not the one you’ll hear about from that podium — but the one built by people supporting each other, defending rights, and refusing to give in to fear. I know so many of you are feeling overwhelmed right now. I hear it everywhere I go. But I want you to know this: your voice matters. Your engagement matters. And your support makes all of this work possible. So, If you believe in meeting this moment with grit and heart... If you believe in defending free speech and constitutional rights... If you believe we must hold this administration accountable... = I’m using every platform I have to bring people together and to push back against the harm being done. But I can’t do it alone. Thank you for standing with me tonight. body:
My guest for tonight’s State of the Union
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2105%2E791427%2EhvUpDm)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260224-1-180&t=2&akid=2105%2E791427%2EhvUpDm) [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260224-1-180&t=3&akid=2105%2E791427%2EhvUpDm)
Friend, tonight is Trump’s State of the Union, and I’m bringing some special guests.
One of them is Aliya Rahman. I sent you a note about her story a few weeks back.
Aliya is a disabled woman with autism from South Minneapolis who has suffered a brain injury. Last month, she was driving to an appointment at the traumatic brain injury center where she receives care when she got stuck in a traffic jam caused by ICE vehicles.
As she tried to navigate her way around, an agent yelled, "Move, I will break your f'ing window." She was given conflicting threats and instructions until suddenly the glass of her passenger side window was shattered. She yelled, "I am disabled!” and an agent responded, "Too late."
An agent pulled out a large knife, cut off her seatbelt, threw her face-first into the ground and leaned on her back. Aliya says shooting pain went through her head, neck and wrists. They handcuffed her and carried her facedown through the street by her cuffed arms and legs.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26.5-Kap5&refcode=em260224-1-180&t=4&akid=2105%2E791427%2EhvUpDm)

Last week, a Texas appeals court heard arguments in a civil lawsuit brought by the State of Texas against our client, Maria Rojas—a Houston-based midwife who has delivered babies and provided essential health care to her community for decades. | [HELP US FIGHT](https://click.everyaction.com/k/126051973/603759962/2141984067?sourceid=1151186&utm_campaign=feb emails&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=mariarojas&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGY0ZjExZS1iZjExLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DDDHqRXvulfW-VFJrNjZDR61e1tRBIwSZSJjRuyES2Y=&emci=76fee318-bf11-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=fdf4f11e-bf11-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=954237)

Maria served low-income, uninsured, Spanish-speaking patients who already face enormous barriers to care. [But instead of honoring her service, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton launched unproven accusations against her—stripping her of her livelihood and shutting down three clinics in the Houston area.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/126051974/603759963/2141984067?sourceid=1151186&utm_campaign=feb emails&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=mariarojas&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGY0ZjExZS1iZjExLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DDDHqRXvulfW-VFJrNjZDR61e1tRBIwSZSJjRuyES2Y=&emci=76fee318-bf11-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=fdf4f11e-bf11-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=954237) What you're seeing is an attorney general grasping at straws and rushing to indict anyone during an election year.

A lower court ruled against Maria despite a shocking lack of evidence. On related criminal charges she was jailed for 10 days until an exorbitant $1.4 million bond was posted—and she is still being forced to wear an ankle monitor.

We are asking the appellate court to reverse the decision that closed these clinics. [My colleagues and I are fighting Texas in court and we're NOT backing down.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/126051975/603759964/2141984067?sourceid=1151186&utm_campaign=feb emails&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=mariarojas&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGY0ZjExZS1iZjExLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DDDHqRXvulfW-VFJrNjZDR61e1tRBIwSZSJjRuyES2Y=&emci=76fee318-bf11-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=fdf4f11e-bf11-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=954237)

| Peter,

**President Trump’s global tariffs were illegal from the start.**

Like many of you, I celebrated the Supreme Court’s moral clarity in striking down Trump’s painful, unconstitutional tariff chaos.

But Trump just doesn’t know when to stop. _He’s doubling down and increasing global tariffs to 15%._

We saw what these tariffs did to our country: **a record-high trade deficit, lost manufacturing jobs and higher prices.**

We can’t take another two years of Trump’s tariff chaos. Congress must immediately step up and pass the Stopping a Rogue President on Trade Act and put an end to this madness once and for all.

As the Ways and Means Trade Subcommittee Ranking Member, I introduced the Stopping a Rogue President on Trade Act to protect working Americans from the harms of Trump’s deranged trade regime by requiring Congressional approval on all new tariffs imposed by the president.

I am leading the charge for working families in Congress, fighting for lower prices and manufacturing jobs in California and nationwide, but I can’t do it alone.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: I’m boycotting Trump’s State of the Union
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
The American people deserve better than two hours of dangerous, dishonest ramblings, and I refuse to sit through it.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260224-5942-footer&t=1&akid=5942%2E420207%2Efjp8kn)
Peter,
**Donald Trump is set to give his State of the Union speech tonight, and I won’t be attending.**
While Trump stands there repeating falsehoods about immigrants, ICE, and his supposed “economic success,” millions of working Americans are living a very different reality. Rising costs, unstable jobs, and policies that favor corporations and the wealthy over everyday families have left people struggling to get by.
The damage isn’t abstract — it’s felt at kitchen tables and in workplaces across the country. Trump’s lies can’t obscure the reality that his backwards priorities are hurting the very people who need real leadership, economic stability, and a fair shot at opportunity.
The American people deserve better than two hours of dangerous, dishonest ramblings, and I refuse to sit through it.
Instead, I’ll continue fighting back against his administration’s dangerous actions, defending immigrant communities, and building a government that works for poor and working people — not Trump’s billionaire allies.
[**If you’re with me, please consider pitching in $3 or anything you can to help power our progressive movement. I can’t do it without you.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260224.Ay7yGR&refcode=em20260224-5942&amount=3&t=2&akid=5942%2E420207%2Efjp8kn)

body:
https://secure.ngpvan.com/XQ3kk2F_m0-wtJXO_GbAkQ2?contactdata=tW7KQ4hMRhOzgCO9mMaJVeGL7MuikNlJ0eJQRhS5+4WSpb2VEP05gbgltvv8XYpih3kTYtp1wjS7TBp2A9rmTe5DyLHUVymPJ7FDgI99UE+IPbNHQfg6Nagdyvdj0HOM [https://secure.ngpvan.com/XQ3kk2F_m0-wtJXO_GbAkQ2?contactdata=tW7KQ4hMRhOzgCO9mMaJVeGL7MuikNlJ0eJQRhS5+4WSpb2VEP05gbgltvv8XYpih3kTYtp1wjS7TBp2A9rmTe5DyLHUVymPJ7FDgI99UE+IPbNHQfg6Nagdyvdj0HOM]
Hi Peter,
Last week we saw more than 200 wildlife advocates in the Capitol, to rally and meet with their legislators in support of the 1.25% for Wildlife bill ( HB 4134 [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2026R1/Measures/Overview/HB4134] ). The support we have shown for this bill has been building since last session. It has just made it out of committee, so we are very close to getting it passed, as it is moving on to the House for a vote. Now is the time to show up more than ever! Will you send your message of support to your representatives? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/XQ3kk2F_m0-wtJXO_GbAkQ2]
Send your message [https://secure.ngpvan.com/XQ3kk2F_m0-wtJXO_GbAkQ2?contactdata=tW7KQ4hMRhOzgCO9mMaJVeGL7MuikNlJ0eJQRhS5+4WSpb2VEP05gbgltvv8XYpih3kTYtp1wjS7TBp2A9rmTe5DyLHUVymPJ7FDgI99UE+IPbNHQfg6Nagdyvdj0HOM]
What would this bill do? 1.25% for Wildlife would secure landmark wildlife and habitat conservation funding by dedicating a small share of Oregon’s tourism lodging tax to our wildlife. Oregon’s lodging tax is currently one of the lowest in the country, and this increase will still keep it at one of the lowest levels, while providing our endangered wildlife with the support they desperately need.
Oregon’s wildlife is at a tipping point. 1.25% for Wildlife is our chance to make a real difference for Oregon’s endangered species.
Take action now and urge your representatives to vote YES on HB 4134! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/XQ3kk2F_m0-wtJXO_GbAkQ2]
Thank you for your support,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Eliza.png]
Eliza Walton (she/they)

# Highlights from the convention
---
| | Hello friends,
I just returned from the **California Democratic Party 2026 State Convention** in _San Francisco_. I’m excited to share a live _report-back_ with you at our **Tuesday Tea with Rose Penelope Yee** this _evening_!
One _major highlight_ from the convention was the **approval of the** _**California Democrats for Justice in Palestine**_ as a **state-chartered organization** within the CA Democratic Party. This is a significant milestone that reflects ongoing engagement, organizing, and advocacy around justice and democratic principles that centers peace and pushes for an end to blank-checks for weapons and war.
**Join me for an on-the-ground recap of San Francisco — from historic progress on justice to an exciting slate of progressive candidates, and big conversations shaping our path forward.**
---

Peter,

Tonight, Donald Trump will stand before the country for his State of the Union address and paint a "glowing" picture of America.

He'll say the economy is booming, _**even though millions of families are still feeling squeezed every time they fill up their gas tank or check out at the grocery store.**_

He'll brag about tax breaks, _**but won't mention how much of that relief went straight to the wealthiest Americans.**_

He'll say he's fighting for everyone, _**after directing Republicans to cut health insurance and threaten coverage for millions of people.**_

And he'll claim America has never been stronger, _**while too many working families are being left behind by an agenda that feels more self-serving than anything else.**_

But Americans don't need a speech to tell us how things are going— _we see it in our communities every day._ That's why Kim keeps doing the work that you hired her to do, full-steam ahead, no matter what's going on on Capitol Hill.

From lowering prescription drug costs to protecting healthcare to standing up to extreme policies that hurt families, **Kim will always be there to help pick up the pieces of our country that Trump is set on destroying.**

The bottom line is this, Peter: Trump can say whatever he wants tonight. But we know something he doesn't–momentum is on our side, and the House is absolutely within reach. If we're going to flip Congress and put a real check on this joke of an administration, it's going to start with this team standing strong right now. Hi there, it’s Abigail Spanberger, Governor of Virginia. I’m preparing to deliver the Democratic response to Donald Trump’s first State of the Union address of his second term tonight – and I wanted to reach out to you directly.
We’re in a defining moment for our country. Families are facing rising costs and our democratic institutions are being tested, but Democrats have a clear, responsible vision for the future – one grounded in economic fairness, national security, and protecting fundamental freedoms.
My message is simple: We can strengthen our economy, safeguard our democracy, and expand opportunity – but only if we choose steady leadership over the political chaos we’re seeing from the current White House.
It’s clear that Americans are tired of the divisive, dangerous agenda coming out of Washington, and luckily, Democrats in the states are taking charge and fighting back. So before I take the stage in a few hours, I’m asking you personally, Derek: Will you split a donation between Tim Kaine and the Democratic Governors Association right now to help elect more Democrats nationwide who will stand in Donald Trump’s way and move America forward? SOTU Tonight: "America at 250"

President Trump delivers his first State of the Union of his second term tonight at 9 p.m. ET, themed "America at 250: Strong, Prosperous and Respected." Trump is expected to address Iran's nuclear brinkmanship, tout his revamped tariff agenda, and demand Democrats end their engineered DHS shutdown. Speaker Johnson and Vice President Vance will flank the president at the dais. Democrats are fracturing — more than two dozen members are [skipping the address](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD1u6zAQhE9DdRKoFU0-FSxeo85pUwo0ubIX5h_EtZTjB05ukG6amcH3fV7Xq6NI-f7hElp_0BpKWGl3ufFOT2yxlOQa769UG_IKEnQvoQe15riOXbA-6Ak6tKMx46wN6H_dw27e3PxmZDDond9AXtR2C-NFg5oDou_IvpckgIJRGqUHhRrVbZymOYBxfhZKvmpwjG3wJTfcD8d0IOVc3qnkwZfURftgrk1M_wUsApbzPIetfGU837UkYKklEpNvApaAqfjdcevbk2qlfO9_ufrGjrF_ZSq5222oJ8VITRuh5D05ij9f_Ac9h4XvAAAA__9D9njB) entirely for a MoveOn.org rally on the National Mall. Press secretary Karoline Leavitt told [Fox News Digital](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL_OozAQxJ8GOiNYHJwULq6h-669Ehl7SVbxH-Q1OI9_Io_wdaORZjTz-_ez_BjyFJ9_TUBtT1pccgtlE7lkeiP7lILhko-wM5YFephEDwLkEv0ytE5bN43Qoh6UGh6TgunevjSocVPr7W5BrvdBmtWtm-vlusFtuI0rtqSvph5AwtArOXUSJ5TrMI4PB8rYRyP7Y3emIHc2RcZ8mkInUozpUil2NoXW61cpOzfjnwbmBuZaa7elT8R6xUID8548FbLcwIwf6w-mE8X3jrAYC2bBqRyipvym-BSbCeQJWXBF3C8HbYopkBXWMLZZu72S98STamT_DIb8d0n5BbxTw_8AAAD__4PZg38) that the speech will highlight how everyday Americans benefit from Trump's policies. Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger delivers the Democratic response. ★★★
Trump's New Tariffs Kick in Today

After the Supreme Court struck down his IEEPA tariffs last Friday, President Trump moved immediately — invoking Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 and imposing a [10% global tariff](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJycULuO3CAU_RrcMTLXLCwFRRp3mzaldQ3XM1fhYQE7Tv4-mvmEdEdHR-f162v7Qk5c7j8xkw9P3mKNGzcsfTT-TT3VmrGP9p3PTmODGYycQYLeStrUFH2IZoGJvLJWOWPBfE4Pb_VHmC0oWD5xR2cUxRDo2PePHRW6Y2L_cpoBNKjZanPTZEjvallcBIvBCT1_nxEH9VuopVN74uAncSn1hWq5hZqn5B9jnF0sPwSsAtbrum4X9geX-6iF_mDmQu0lFbCeNXH4K2A9uGAJJLFESaGWml-s1sYp5wSs77USY-bCfbR3nOR81k5dqlneU90xyYGNj0PAOjUfz4tT4m6s0PM9I6d3v_Eflz49_AsAAP__XSmJNw) effective today, with the White House confirming it is working toward a 15% rate. Senate Democrats responded with a dead-on-arrival [$175 billion tariff refund bill](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDHO3CAQRk-DO1ZmQNguKNK4-9OmtDDMrtFvwGLG6-T2kbfIAdK94mnm0_v1tXz5tKfy-ukzuvBOS6xxSc0X4pa-kfZasyduZz4IeYEerOxBglnKvqguuhCthg6dGgY12QHs2G3OoLbr0w5a4zgijJNXSmmtw_icQg9Tl9x9qQcwoPrB2IdBi2ZVWk8RBh8mYfrziJ6RHqEWwvb2nN6YSqk31fIINXe725gPEvqHgFnAfF3XY22YePWNb0PAjKGWmv8ImO-XAuYePixg_qfK9aRUkEjG9EJiyRtKOo-GGWWoZ2N5NwjfMtarSPYtPZ8kN2xI8to8y1Azkiz4mwXMXXPxuNK-J7KDMP0r-7R_BvN_NH47-BsAAP__fiyNsg) — pure midterm theater. The administration is simultaneously launching national security investigations under Sections 232 and 301 to build permanent tariff authority beyond the [150-day window](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLuuozAQQL_GdI7wxDKXwsU2dHfbLdFgT5LRxTayB9j8_Yp8wnanODrz-PM9fyOvnJ-_MZEPB8-xxJkr5iaVf6itpSRsUve0NZIZenC6Bw12zutsuuhDdHfoyJthMKMbwH11L-_wgcYCLF8BMMTR2h7AhCXYhx2HcezYX6UewILpB-tulhzZxdzvY4QBw6hsv28RhdotlNyoHih8EOdcLir5FkrqVv8S2Zq6_1IwKZjO87wtlVgWrHIZCiYKJZf0VjBdIxVMPVxsFEyfs3SltpUcm5ai275VSqRD2avo5a05H-WH81NnOrVg5cdD4y6vUlneGnPUoWL-GCxXQV6kE_5VMHXVx-3kdeXmBmX7Z0JeP2vLf3z68PAvAAD__24okCY) authorized by Section 122. The trade agenda lives. Anyone who declared it dead on Friday morning was wrong by Friday night. ★★★

Trump's warning that America is "locked and loaded" hits different now — these protesters watched Maduro get dragged out of Caracas in handcuffs. The mullahs spent forty years chanting "Death to America"; now their own people are [begging America for help](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD1uxCAQhU-DO1swZmFdUKSh27QprTGQXbT8WIDtHD8iR0j39I1m9M37eqwP9MGn5ydGp8zpV5vt6gum2op_uxpyjlhbOeJeXVuBghgpjMDXFFY2WGWsmGFwiknJFiFB3IeX2jggUuTLxhFvIDZcmLtRuM9muX9TM3jVL1EADoxKLibuhOMbm-fFgkSzEE6P3WJzdTI5VVdObP50PqXcU06TyXEI6tXaXsn8QUAT0Nd1TcldNeJPn3eSS7AE9DPkDUPD8Cagjzr2F8d0mOCwjB1XAro7EdAUep4JaN9XGXBJJSOgh6LsfvkQfBWScPqM6MOfSPtHd6eC3wAAAP__8e579Q).

body:
People all over are talking about what’s at stake in Virginia this spring.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260224-230&t=1&akid=230%2E12592%2EzyUq3Y)
Hey, did you see what Aaron Parnas said about the Virginia redistricting vote?
In a short video, Aaron breaks down what’s at stake — and why this moment matters for voters across the Commonwealth.
[**Watch the full video here:**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/1074?t=2&akid=230%2E12592%2EzyUq3Y)
The most important point he makes is simple: **_Voters get to decide._**
This amendment isn’t about politicians protecting themselves or quietly reshaping maps behind closed doors. It’s about giving Virginians a real say about what happens in the midterm elections, with full transparency and accountability. Voters get to see the proposed maps and voters get the final say at the ballot box.
That’s why this message is resonating, and why regular people everywhere are sharing it.
Right now, we have momentum. But to turn that momentum into a YES vote, we need to make sure voters in Virginia understand what this amendment does and how it protects their voice in Washington.
[**Can you help us spread the word? Your support will help Virginians for Fair Elections reach voters statewide and make sure they have the facts before the vote.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260224_2.MHXava&amount=3&refcode=20260224-230&t=3&akid=230%2E12592%2EzyUq3Y)

body:
| | Peter,

Four years ago, I made a big decision that completely changed my life: I launched my campaign for Congress.

I was tired of our communities being ignored by politicians who are more interested in catering to extremes than helping everyday people and tired of divisive and hateful rhetoric that pits neighbors against each other, and I just couldn’t sit by and wait for someone else to fix it.

So, our scrappy team got to work building a people-powered campaign. It wasn’t easy, but we knew that giving Southwest Washington an independent voice in Congress was worth fighting for.

**No one thought we would flip this seat, but thanks to sustained grassroots support from folks like you, we defied the odds and won.**

[Now, we need to prove that we still have what it takes to win this toss-up race once again and keep WA-03 loyal to the soil. They’re trying to make it harder for you to vote.
Congressional Republicans just passed the SAVE Act and introduced the so-called MEGA Act — sweeping federal bills that would impose new proof-of-citizenship requirements and strict ID mandates on voters nationwide.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260224em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260224em]
Let me be clear: this isn’t about election security. It’s about voter suppression.
As Oregon’s chief elections officer, I joined five other Democratic secretaries of state in opposing these bills because they would place a massive burden on eligible voters, create unfunded mandates for states, and inject chaos into election systems just as the 2026 midterms ramp up.
These bills would force voters to jump through bureaucratic hoops, spend more time and money proving their eligibility, or risk losing access to the ballot altogether. That is not how democracy should work.
In Oregon, we’ve built one of the most secure and accessible voting systems in the country. I will fight any attempt to undermine it — whether it comes from billionaires spreading lies or politicians in Washington trying to score partisan points.
But I need your support to keep standing up for voters.
If you believe voting should be free, fair, and accessible — not complicated and costly — please chip in $10 or $25 today to help us defend Oregon’s elections. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260224em]

name: Nani
subject: A new way for dads to connect
body:
Are you a dad or do you know a dad? Dads for All helps dads connect.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/fc9316adbb27/a-new-way-for-dads-to-connect?e=7e921d898f)
---
| | | | Hi Peter,
I know how hard we all work for our kids – moms and dads alike – and sometimes it can feel isolating. So I wanted to share a new opportunity that might be of interest to you or a dad in your life.
Our friends at [**Dads for All**](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=db642f5b87&e=7e921d898f), one of the great parenting groups out there, just launched **Dads Stand Up — a national chapter program that brings fathers together through fun, friendship, and real local action.** No politics. No lectures. Just dads building community around what they already love and making a visible difference where their families live.
---
**They’re looking for dads who want to start their own chapters where they live.**
| [Learn more and apply](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=303f41bea2&e=7e921d898f)
---
| | **Chapter leads get:** → Up to $4,000 to fund gatherings and activities→ Coaching and support from the Dads for All founding team→ A national network of chapter leads doing the same work→ Resources, event templates, and proven strategies from their pilot work
In the events they’ve already held, their results speak for themselves: 90%+ of dads felt more connected to other fathers, and left more motivated to improve their communities.**They're selecting 5 pilot cities for a March–June 2026 launch. Applications close March 6th.**
If this sounds like something you or a dad you know would be great at, we encourage you to apply.
Learn more and apply: [**https://www.dadsforall.com/dads-stand-up**](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=860a4b1dec&e=7e921d898f)
Nani

name: Tim Walz
subject: It’s retaliation
body:
Peter,
When I demanded transparency and accountability for what’s happening in Minnesota, the Department of Justice turned its attention to me.
That’s not a coincidence. It’s retaliation.
This is how authoritarian politics work: overwhelm your critics, weaponize the justice system, and make the cost of speaking up so high that people stop doing it.
I won’t stop, because Minnesota believes in the rule of law. We believe in dignity. We believe real public safety comes from trust and cooperation — not fear, chaos, or political theater.
But fighting back against this kind of retaliation is expensive by design. And that’s why I’m asking for your help.
If you’re able, please contribute $25 to our Legal Defense Fund and Real Texas today so we can keep standing up for Minnesotans, defending the rule of law, and pushing back against this abuse of power. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp_2026_dga?refcode=partner_ms_tw_em_20260224_realtexaspac]
I'm grateful,
Tim Walz

Friends, I’m suing Trump and RFK Jr.
Here's why:
Under their leadership, HHS and the CDC have thrown science out the window.
They’re flouting decades of research, ignoring medical experts, and threatening to strain state resources. And most importantly, they are risking making America’s children sicker.
It’s unconscionable, illogical, and illegal. That’s why today, for the 59th time, I’m taking the Trump administration to court — because kids and families deserve better.
Our lawsuit is against Trump’s unlawful overhaul of the childhood vaccine schedule — a reckless move that puts millions of kids at risk, undermines long-standing and evidence-based science, and threatens to strain our state health systems.
RFK Jr. is one of the most prominent anti-vaccine voices in the country, who has led a dangerous movement to erode public trust in safe and effective vaccines.
Now, he’s illegally purged the CDC’s federal vaccine advisory committee and replaced its expertise with unqualified appointees, including anti-vaccine advocates. And he’s stripped seven essential vaccines from the vaccine schedule, without any new evidence or medical recommendations, causing widespread confusion.
Vaccines save lives, and they save trillions of dollars in healthcare costs.
California will not sit on the sidelines while children’s health is put at risk and federal agencies break the law.
If you believe decisions about our children’s health should be based on scientific evidence and not personal opinion or political agendas, I need you to be a part of this fight. Please chip in today to help me hold this administration accountable to the law. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]

body:
Friend,
Last week, I sent over a note about President Trump’s reckless efforts to block the Gordie Howe International Bridge – a project that means jobs, trade, and lower costs for Michigan families.
Now we’ve learned something new.
Just weeks before the Administration moved to block the bridge, Matthew Moroun – whose family owns the competing Ambassador Bridge – gave _$1 million_ to the President’s super PAC.
**At a minimum, the timing raises serious questions.**
Friend, when MAGA dark money floods our system, decisions stop being about what’s best for working families – and start being about who can write the biggest check.
And in a swing district like ours, we know exactly what that means: more outside money flooding in to try and buy this seat. In fact, it’s already happening – we’ve faced more than $1 million in dark-money spending trying to lie about me and buy this seat.
In order to push back – and keep fighting for working families here in mid-Michigan – it’s going to take real grassroots support. Can you chip in $3 now?

**\------ Forwarded Message ------**
From: Kristen McDonald Rivet
Date: Feb 18, 2026, 4:00 PM
Subject: Another day, and another inexplicable move by this White House

Friend,
Another day, and another inexplicable move by this White House that will wreak havoc on working families in Michigan.
This time, President Trump is threatening new tariffs on Canada and trying to block the Gordie Howe International Bridge from opening – a decade-in-the-making, bipartisan project, fueled by union labor, that will be a game changer in the supply chain between the US and Canada – which means more jobs and lower costs.
When the President picks a fight like this, it created chaos for our manufacturers and small businesses and jacks up the price of everyday goods.
**And when our economy takes a hit because of this, it’s Michigan workers and families that pay the price.**
Meanwhile, my opponent says he supports President Trump's tariffs, calling this chaotic policy “the new normal”. He won’t defend the bridge. He won’t stand up to Trump – even when Michigan jobs are on the line.
We deserve better than that, friend.
In Congress, I’ve been fighting for working families – working to lower everyday costs, expand access to health care, and make sure mid-Michigan families can count on good-paying jobs and a stable economy.
I won’t stay silent while the President plays politics with our economy – and I’ll stand up to anyone who threatens Michigan jobs or puts our economy at risk.
